We are through game one of the double header. The voters have spoken, and they chose me to be the Republican candidate for Senate in California. With housing prices hovering near all time highs, Americans have been shelling out [more than $100 billion a year in commissions to sell real estate](https://substack.com/redirect/125a38da-b920-42f3-a800-ece69f0d9863?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This enormous sum is the result of a standard commission rate while housing prices have risen a fair amount over the past few decades.
I've personally been involved in more than a dozen real estate transactions, most of which involved a real estate sales person or two. I have always -- and I mean ALWAYS -- been confused by why the real estate brokerage fees were so high. I still recall thinking it was highway robbery for a sales agent to take 6% of the transaction as a fee for facilitating a sale. Many of my friends outside the United States agreed with me, noting American commission rates were way above levels in their countries. In fact, _The_ _Wall Street Journal_ even ran a story last fall with the headline of "[Almost No One Pays a 6% Real-Estate Commission--Except Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/36b702d8-5eab-4137-9923-74ab4f0470b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" that highlighted how American real estate sales commissions were among the highest in the world. _The New York Times,_ citing a study by investment firm Keefe, Brunette, & Woods, elaborated on this dynamic, noting "[Commision rates are significantly lower in many other countries. In Britain, they are just above 1 percent, while in Singapore, the Netherlands, and Denmark, they hover between 2 and 3 percent](https://substack.com/redirect/11de2920-60ab-4e7a-99bb-d2070b536929?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..L6WYOmHvDGsgs7E2gHA6QCk9Y-tnbJmo0t5xBvtLxsM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=142707161)
This is all about to change. Last week, the National Association of Realtors (NAR), the nation's largest association of real estate professionals, agreed in principle to settle lawsuits that had argued that NAR had _de facto_ set a standard commission rate, violating antitrust laws. Without a standard rate (around 6% in most of America), real estate sales professionals would have had to lower their commission rates to secure business. The settlement involved a large fine, but more importantly, an agreement that NAR would eliminate its rules on commissions.
Historically, NAR had a rule that required seller agents to clearly advertise the percentage of the transaction value that would be paid to a buyer's agent. According to the lawsuits, this rule basically set compensation for agents representing buyers, stifled competition, and "[led to a practice called 'steering' in which buyer agents direct their clients to more expensive homes where the agents stand to earn a large commission](https://substack.com/redirect/11de2920-60ab-4e7a-99bb-d2070b536929?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." The settlement, which still needs to be approved by a court, stops realtors from advertising commission rates to buyers' agents. While this may not seem like a big deal, housing experts are already describing the settlement as "[one of the most significant jolts in the U.S. housing market in 100 years](https://substack.com/redirect/43318d72-4c79-42b3-a7b4-2bd4d0065766?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."

### _Forthcoming Changes in How We 'll Buy and Sell Homes_
I think there are three primary ways the way we buy and sells homes will change. First, real estate commissions are likely to fall as the settlement allows for more fee negotiation by both buyers and sellers. Second, the change will also create an opportunity for business model innovation as those involved in the real estate transaction industry might unbundle services and price each separately. Lastly, I believe the number of salespeople in the real estate industry could shrink.
Because buyer agents would no longer be compensated by the seller (even if the value was de facto embedded in the sales price), buyers might be left with less representation or might have to pay for representation directly. Previously, the sale of a $500,000 home might result in $30,000 of commissions, often split $15,000 for the seller's agent and $15,000 for the buyer's agent. The seller would receive a net $470,000 (before fees). Let's assume competition drives the seller agent standard fee down from 3% to 2% as more and more agents seek to represent sellers rather than buyers. Let's further assume that buyers will have to pay directly for representation.
If this hypothetical scenario were to unfold, the seller would receive $490,000 and the buyer might end up paying $500,000 plus whatever they might have committed to paying a buyers agent. But with online databases with complete real estate listings, how much would a buyer be willing to pay for someone to drive them to tour homes, negotiate documents, or provide market intelligence? My suspicion is that it may prove to be less than the amount of commission paid by the seller, implying total commission for the sale would be less than $20,000, a meaningful drop from the previous $30,000.

[In late February 2024, the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond published a paper written by two of its economists entitled "Real Estate Commissions and Homebuying."](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7106bf-9f3a-48de-8f33-5b45eb6c276c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Although the paper is filled with equations and greek characters, it has some noteworthy findings. Specifically, the economists conclude that a system that allows homebuyers to pay "a la carte" for services would likely lead to buyers touring fewer homes and negotiating lower purchase prices. The net reduction in commissions paid could be, according to their findings, as high as $30 billion.
Further, given other countries that don't have anti-competitive price setting have significantly lower rates, it's highly likely that commission rates will fall. As mentioned above, other developed nations have real estate commission rates meaningfully below America's current rates. Another oft-cited example is the plunge in travel agent commission upon the introduction of online travel agencies such as Kayak and Expedia that empowered customers with more information.
Greater transparency in real estate commissions will probably also drive an unbundling of real estate services. Will real estate agents representing buyers start charging per home tour? Might agents representing sellers charge per showing? Or could some agents start charging an hourly rate to compensate for time spent negotiating terms or accompanying home inspectors? Or perhaps real estate agents will price their services for a fixed fee? Will sellers be asked to pay for professional pictures, marketing brochures, or a promotional website? And of course, let's not forget about the increasing role of technologies to provide both buyers and sellers information and the ability to research and market directly.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..L6WYOmHvDGsgs7E2gHA6QCk9Y-tnbJmo0t5xBvtLxsM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=142707161)
It's also likely services offered will vary according to the transaction value. A flat $15,000 listing fee might be unacceptably high for a seller expecting to sell her home for $300,000, but might be seen as a bargain for someone expecting to sell her home for $1,000,000. Some buyers might be willing to pay for services such as research on community services, school offerings, or even the proximity of golf courses. Under certain scenarios, commissions paid might actually rise.
In aggregate, the disruption to the commission model is likely to lead to less revenues for professionals engaged in real estate transactions, a development that likely points to less employment in the industry going forward. If commissions were to fall by 33% (as per the example above), might industry employment fall by a similar amount? In early 2024, the National Association of Realtors website indicated that it represented more than 1.5 million real estate professionals. Could membership fall to under 1 million? How will a smaller real estate transaction industry impact the economy?
### _Will Home Prices Rise or Fall?_
Perhaps the most interesting and important topic to ask about the impact of this settlement is how it might affect home prices. How will a change in the real estate commission rates impact values? While it's too early to tell, several scenarios can help us navigate the inevitable uncertainty.

* * *
One possibility is that **home prices fall** as sellers share the benefits of lower fees with buyers. Using the example above, let's assume that our seller wanted to get $470,000 net of commissions and therefore listed his house for $500,000. But if the listing agent only charged a 2% commission, that would lead to a listing price of slightly less than $480,000, implying a 4% drop from the original $500,000 listing price.
There is, however, another scenario worth thinking about, one in which **home prices rise** as a result of more demand. If our seller listed his house for $500,000 and realized the $490,000 as described above, he would have an additional $20,000 to put toward the downpayment of his next home, implying he could afford to pay more. Might that lead to higher real estate prices?
Of course, it would be naive to think that transaction costs are the only driver of real estate values. As I've written about elsewhere, consumer confidence and [interest rates are important factors that impact real estate values](https://substack.com/redirect/f0d03dbc-5a80-4e59-a817-4acfbc15c596?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). As does supply of available homes and the demand for those homes. And of course, every geography is different and faces different demographic considerations. Amidst this uncertainty, one development seems certain: greater transparency in real estate commissions will empower both sellers and buyers and should lead to a more efficient market.

Perhaps the most interesting and important topic to ask about the impact of this settlement is how it might affect home prices. How will a change in the real estate commission rates impact values? While it's too early to tell, several scenarios can help us navigate the inevitable uncertainty. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Jan 7 | One possibility is that home prices fall as sellers share the benefits of lower fees with buyers. Using the example above, let's assume that our seller wanted to get $470,000 net of commissions and therefore listed his house for $500,000. But if the listing agent only charged a 2% commission, that would lead to a listing price of slightly less than $480,000, implying a 4% drop from the original $500,000 listing price. There is, however, another scenario worth thinking about, one in which home prices rise as a result of more demand. If our seller listed his house for $500,000 and realized the $490,000 as described above, he would have an additional $20,000 to put toward the downpayment of his next home, implying he could afford to pay more. Might that lead to higher real estate prices? Of course, it would be naive to think that transaction costs are the only driver of real estate values. As I've written about elsewhere, consumer confidence and . As does supply of available homes and the demand for those homes. And of course, every geography is different and faces different demographic considerations. Amidst this uncertainty, one development seems certain: greater transparency in real estate commissions will empower both sellers and buyers and should lead to a more efficient market. | | POLL How do you think the NAR settlement will impact real estate values? (assuming no change to interest rates) | ? ? ? | | ---|---|--- VIKRAM MANSHARAMANI is an entrepreneur, consultant, scholar, neighbor, husband, father, volunteer, and professional generalist who thinks in multiple-dimensions and looks beyond the short-term. Self-taught to think around corners and connect original dots, he spends his time speaking with global leaders in business, government, academia, and journalism. subject: I hope you’ll hear me out
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Folks,

As a team, we have achieved so much together over the past five years.

In 2018, we did what many said was impossible and made history by electing the youngest Black woman to ever serve in Congress.

Then this team overcame staggering political odds in 2020 by propelling me to my second term by just 5,374 votes in one of the top 10 closest House races of the election.

Fast forward to the 2022 midterms: We rallied together to face a significant hurdle following Illinois’ redistricting process that made 70% of IL-14 brand-new territory with voters who had never seen my name on their ballot before. And that brings us to today, as I am proudly serving my third term in Congress and my first in House leadership.

With your support, I've been able to champion critical legislation improving health care access and lowering premiums for a record 21.3 million Americans, reducing the cost of insulin for seniors, rebuilding our nation’s infrastructure with a once-in-a-generation investment, addressing the climate crisis, making our communities safer, and so much more.

_Over the last five years, I’ve had 14 pieces of legislation signed into law under two different administrations._

Looking back at our many accomplishments has me feeling hopeful and eager to show that, once again, we have what it takes to defend this seat.

We have proven time and again that our team is capable of accomplishing anything that we set our mind to.

As you know, our work is far from over. With election season in full swing, we find ourselves facing new challenges and new opponents.

I’m running for reelection this November to build on our work to reclaim and protect reproductive rights, reform our nation’s deeply unequal health care system, make life better for our working families, and so much more. But I can’t do any of it without you.

_I don’t take a single supporter on this team for granted, and know that I must continue the hard work for our district to earn your trust and vote each election._

**That’s why I am humbly asking for your support on my reelection campaign this year. Folks, this grassroots team has been an invaluable part of our success from the very beginning, and I would be honored to have you continue alongside me on this journey.**

subject: The Mountain Minute: 3/18/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| |
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Hello, We're eager to bring you today's newsletter, featuring ONLY Rocky Mountain Voice original content. We're excited to move more toward citizen journalism, featuring voices just like yours with first-hand accounts of what's happening to our liberties as we battle for our great state. This is the Mountain Minute for Monday, March 18, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Plea deal gives former producer at Sounds True lenient sentence for possession of 6,000 images of sexual child abuse**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
Mitchell Clute, 57, a former senior producer and editor at Sounds True, has agreed to a plea deal, according to various media reports, on charges of possessing and distributing child sexual abuse material. He was arrested in July, following an investigation by the Boulder County Digital Forensics Lab, which discovered child sexual abuse material downloaded from an IP address associated with Clute’s residence on Dewey Avenue. Initially facing 11 felony charges, including sexual exploitation of a child, Clute accepted a very lenient plea deal last week, pleading guilty to two counts of sexual exploitation of a child, both class 4 felonies. The remaining charges were dismissed as part of the agreement. The sentencing, on March 8, saw Clute receive only 60 days of work release and six years of sex offender intensive supervised probation. Additionally, he will be required to register as a sex offender. Despite arguments from Deputy District Attorney Taylor Suta for a punitive sanction of 90 days and six years of probation, Clute’s defense attorney, Benjamin Greenberg, attributed his client’s actions to addiction, advocating for a more lenient approach. **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**Overbeck: Democrats in Colorado Legislature push bills endangering your children**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY JOY OVERBECK, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Democrats in the Colorado Legislature rejected [House Bill 24-1092](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), proposed by Rep. Brandi Bradley, which aimed to increase sentences for child predators, allowing them to avoid jail time.

* Instead, Democrats are sponsoring [HB24-1039](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which mandates schools to recognize students' chosen gender identities, potentially putting children on a path toward irreversible gender transition.

* The bill's proponents argue for gender-affirming care, including puberty blockers and hormones, despite growing concerns and bans on such treatments in other countries. Additionally, [HB24-1071](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) allows convicted felons to change their names without notifying the court, potentially enabling sex offenders to hide their identities and evade detection.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
[**Ahead of Tuesday deadline, only three have sufficiently met signature threshold for a place on ballot for Congress**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Only three candidates for Congress have successfully gathered enough signatures to petition for a place on the primary ballot: Democrat Joe Neguse in the 2nd District, Republican Curtis McCrackin in the 3rd District, and Republican Lauren Boebert in the 4th District.

* The deadline for filing petitions with the Secretary of State’s office is Tuesday, March 19, with the online form indicating the status of filed petitions and their sufficiency.

* Petitions for Republican Deborah Flora in the 4th District and Jeff Crank in the 5th District have been returned but await verification of sufficiency, while four petitions have been withdrawn by candidates. Several petitions submitted in the State Senate, State House, and for district attorney positions await confirmation of their sufficiency.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**RMGO leaders, members to rally Tuesday morning against “assault weapons” ban**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Rocky Mountain Gun Owners will rally on the west steps of the state capitol at 8 a.m. Tuesday, March 19, in opposition to specific anti-gun legislation under consideration.

**
* [House Bill 1292](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), by Democrat Reps. Elisabeth Epps and Tim Hernandez, to prohibit “assault weapons” will be heard by the House Judiciary Committee Tuesday at the Old State Library. The bill has a broad definition of “assault weapon”, which could make rifled barrel pistols and rifles illegal, along with pistol grip shotguns, and many other guns.

* Additionally, [Senate Bill 131](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), known as the “sensitive spaces” gun bill, will be heard at 1:30 p.m. Wednesday in the Senate Judiciary Committee at the Old Supreme Court.

* The invitation shared with Rocky Mountain Gun Owners members announced a “Save Our Second” rally with RMGO Board President Dudley Brown, Executive Director Taylor Rhodes and Brandon Herrera, known as the “AK Guy”.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️** [**No comment: In Weld County, commissioners have removed public’s opportunity to speak at meetings**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | LOCAL, NORTHERN COLORADO | MARCH 15** _A collection of residents in Weld County argued, during a town hall meeting here Wednesday, they should have an opportunity to express opinions and engage with officials they elected._ [**John Fabbricatore Considering Run for CD-4 Special Election**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY RMV STAFF | STATE | MARCH 14** _In a statement released last week, John Fabbricatore, a seasoned professional with decades of service in U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), including during the Trump administration, declared his candidacy for the upcoming special election in Colorado’s 4th Congressional District._ **[21st Judicial District slates open house for Juvenile Diversion, Lighthouse programs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF | LOCAL, WESTERN SLOPE | MARCH 13** _An open house has been announced for 2-6 p.m. Wednesday, March 20, during which time the public will be invited by the 21st Judicial District Attorney’s Office to tour new space of the Juvenile Diversion and Lighthouse Program at Colorado Mesa University, 1060 Orchard Ave._ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)[@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)) or send us a message on social media to chat!
# 🤔 DID YOU KNOW?

Colorado once had **3 Governors in a single day** \- On March 17, 1905, Democrat Alva Adams, left, was forced to resign because of election improprieties (one district had 717 votes for Adams but only 100 registered voters). He was replaced by Republican James H. Peabody, who had run against him in the election, on the condition that he immediately resign. He did so, yielding to his Lieutenant Governor, Jesse F. McDonald.

subject: Get “The Federalist Papers” on DVD
body:
You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31954%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=M6MmIcwvHXYGJkkR86rBTQ&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest--with an Ivy League degree--said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31965%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=u6eUL1pFVbEcc8%2bzrsD8Iw&sysid=1)**** on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

---

Hillsdale’s faculty teach the course, and it will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. These DVDs also make a great gift for someone unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles--maybe even a friend or family member. But supplies are limited. So, be sure to get this special edition of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ on DVD today. More than 200,000 people have already taken this course, so this DVD box set won’t last long. Dear
Fellow Patriot,
If you
opened this email because you remember my playing days with the
Dodgers and the Padres, thank you.

Having
you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey
Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we
battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees...
...well,
as they say, "Those were the days."
But this
email isn't about baseball. In fact, it's a email I never thought
I'd be writing to you.

Today,
I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a
seat in the United States Senate.
As of
March 5th, it's official. I'm going head-to-head with Adam Schiff
in November.
Democrat
policies have brought America to its knees.
There's
fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime,
homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding
and for the first time causing more people to leave California.
Joe
Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one
bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to
say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and
dependent.
And
that's why I'm running for Senate.
We
Republicans pulled our country out of the 1970's Democratic
malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.
And I
believe we can do it again by putting classic conservative values
at the heart of everything we do.
But there
is no way I can pull it off without you.
Will you
rush a contribution to my campaign of $35 or more today?
I've
lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell
you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never
seen before.
They are
hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters
in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of
California...
I know we
can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win.
I'm
fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake
-- I'm not just taking the field for Californians.
When we
win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical
Adam Schiff...
...we
start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country
desperately needs.
Thank you
and God Bless,

Steve
Garvey

Republican for United States Senate

Chesterfield GOP Election TONIGHT
| | | |
# VOTE TONIGHT
---
|
# REMEMBER
# THEY DON'T WANT YOU TO VOTE
---
|
# CHESTERFIELD REPUBLICANS
# VOTE TONIGHT from
# 5:30-7:30pm
# Swift Creek Middle School
---
|
# VOTE FOR THE
# "RE-UNIFY THE RED" TICKET
---
|
# NO GOP MEMBERSHIP NEEDED TO VOTE
---
|
# VOTE DEE DEE VANBUREN
# FOR CHESTERFIELD GOP CHAIR
---
| Friends, Many of you are asking very good questions.
Why is there only ONE location to vote? Why is it voters only have a 2 hour time span of when they can cast a vote? What if I have a conflict, can I vote absentee? (The answer is no.) Why is this election not publicized in the news? Why am I not receiving information on voting? Would true Republicans hold an election in a gun free zone?
Here's the answer.
It's by design. The GOP elitists don't want you to vote.
That's exactly why we are challenging current GOP leadership and seeking to replace them. Can we count on your vote tonight?
The current GOP leadership is counting on you to come up with an excuse as to why you can't make it tonight.
They know the hardcore party faithful will show up during the 2 hours. The current GOP leadership has been prepping their people for weeks. They are committed. They understand that if they win tonight, they keep their power.
They are counting on you to not show up. They want to continue to stay in power and stay in control of which Republicans get nominated and the method in which they are nominated. That's a lot of power. And they don't want to give it up. So they've planned an election that will last only 2 hours on a week day in one location.
You can complain. But it will do no good. It's a private organization and they control the process.
The only way to win is to overwhelm their vote and be determined that no matter what stunt they pull at the last minute, you will be vigilant and steadfast in casting your vote for Dee Dee Van Buren and the "Re-unify the Red" ticket before you leave.
Call every person you know and tell them they absolutely must pull out all of the stops to vote tonight. Otherwise, we end up with the same handful of people calling all of the shots, giving voters limited and confusing options at election time, so that they can select their handpicked candidate. Do you want them to chose who you will get to vote for in June and ultimately November?
I know that you are just as disgusted as I am. You may have heard what they did to me and so many others. But now is our chance for "We the People" to take back the Chesterfield GOP and put it in the hands of Constitution loving Virginians who believe in fair, transparent and honest elections.
Please tell all of your friends who live in Chesterfield to get out and vote tonight, Tuesday, March 19.
We need to replace them. And now is our chance.
We need fresh new leadership in the Chesterfield GOP, which is why I encourage all conservatives and Republicans living in Chesterfield to get out and vote for the: "RE-UNIFY THE RED" slate of candidates this coming Tuesday, March 19 between the hours of 5:30pm and 7:30pm at Swift Creek Middle School. It will only take a few minutes to vote and you don't need to stay.
Rumor is that the establishment GOP old guard is going to get their people out early so that there is a long line and you won't stay to vote.
So get there early. And be determined to vote, no matter what they try to pull.
You don't need to be a member of the Chesterfield GOP to vote. Tell every Republican you know who lives in Chesterfield to get out and vote for the Re-unify the Red slate.
I am confident that Dee Dee Van Buren and the "Re-unify the Red" slate will bring all Republicans together, work hard to elect Donald J Trump this November, and will actively work to grow the current membership of the Chesterfield GOP, so that we can ensure Chesterfield County stays "red."
Be determined to vote today and call everyone you know who lives in Chesterfield to turn out and vote so that we can make the Chesterfield GOP great again.

body:
As a candidate in 2022, Hillary Scholten sold herself to West Michigan voters as some kind of mainstream moderate, but her voting record shows nothing more than party-line orthodoxy.
| | |
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SLaBRENVU_oF_lv0fnfdA2hAYSlRFxkMPZtuQbma0BDUqIVO5xUT5hotaavisC7L_IaUgvFcfcEo4pAu2gVTatb-KGWaTcJK6M4usiD-vvzY36h2lVD0hSfegZda_lmT8jcJifZRxclyPAO3oTuRvcskcTZfBTiJ&c=n0ZK5xFUgo1CaBSjoaPsvPK3ktkbMVp9p0oOrtB21KEgpLwpx2iTBA==&ch=LMGzd3zUY5EjSLUrYIYrpcxQABTvN5waFtyKpzDbkBTIIR3CScqpJQ==)
---
|
Friend
To most people, the term 'bipartisan' means a style of constructive engagement with the other political party and a genuine interest in working cooperatively. But politicians like Hillary Scholten use this term to camouflage their real ideology.
---
| As a candidate in 2022, Hillary Scholten sold herself to West Michigan voters as some kind of mainstream moderate, but those who have closely watched her in Washington see nothing more than party-line orthodoxy in her votes.
The independent non-profit Common Ground Committee rates all House and Senate members on bipartisanship. Despite all of Rep. Scholten's political posturing, she falls in the 'below average' category according to their review, with a score of just 17 out of 100.
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SLaBRENVU_oF_lv0fnfdA2hAYSlRFxkMPZtuQbma0BDUqIVO5xUT5queJwjzaP6dBAHVnZ1kcc_45BSgPB0y66Iovvj9WEeGZT8Rllyd_5F35vof895nCP5Ey6GMBj-P6iaaTacfJI50ciKAb-2xOBU14duzVVbp6vPFLPgKb7mFKrZBHNsycQ==&c=n0ZK5xFUgo1CaBSjoaPsvPK3ktkbMVp9p0oOrtB21KEgpLwpx2iTBA==&ch=LMGzd3zUY5EjSLUrYIYrpcxQABTvN5waFtyKpzDbkBTIIR3CScqpJQ==)
---
| To get a sense for how out of step Hillary is with both the Third Congressional District and Michigan generally, her bipartisan score was abysmal compared to her Michigan delegation colleagues. Out of 13 members, Rep. Scholten ranks 10th in her willingness to work across the aisle.
The numbers don't lie. After promising to be one of the most bipartisan members in Congress, Scholten got to Congress and has voted party-line 96% of the time.
---
| | [HELP END HILLARY SCHOLTEN'S PARTISAN AGENDA](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SLaBRENVU_oF_lv0fnfdA2hAYSlRFxkMPZtuQbma0BDUqIVO5xUT5queJwjzaP6dwHkDn288tAPffJJvNsm82Z0gOB2e4HUQGi97E_V8G1X9QlprftJl4bg8UK-chCFKl5XZ9jtXPam0WiJHwDPdATCZr8WPnqNb9vKOdfU-fGeoUkR6oUvKV6l4jjVV6RjJuBr1EaOY1My_ozkxgwmD-FKdU3nFWCDNhErknL9g2OubO2SFB336HMYs1XpsjJH0XKER1SXx-K0UBxEjn1oPswOmv7mTYpP4Y_d3nLYPDAsJgHSxjXiiPiGGhuIM6cWPy86hS6oa8ucA2NACrTdOvg==&c=n0ZK5xFUgo1CaBSjoaPsvPK3ktkbMVp9p0oOrtB21KEgpLwpx2iTBA==&ch=LMGzd3zUY5EjSLUrYIYrpcxQABTvN5waFtyKpzDbkBTIIR3CScqpJQ==)
---
|
On top of that, Big Labor's scorecard on Hillary shows she's in lockstep with 90% of their agenda, while a conservative Washington policy group gives her a '0' score. So much for bipartisan voting behavior.
As a [candidate](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SLaBRENVU_oF_lv0fnfdA2hAYSlRFxkMPZtuQbma0BDUqIVO5xUT5hotaavisC7LtrIS51cwzm1N8RxL9orwfjAOaA_urj8UVH3YOwrvzhdHReTGxes5E5Imxe36TKlXGzErNu88y7TVsvqkcxBwkbjnfG6F7Oc2&c=n0ZK5xFUgo1CaBSjoaPsvPK3ktkbMVp9p0oOrtB21KEgpLwpx2iTBA==&ch=LMGzd3zUY5EjSLUrYIYrpcxQABTvN5waFtyKpzDbkBTIIR3CScqpJQ==) I hope this November election is an honest discussion of who is best able to represent the interests and values of West Michigan. Toward that end, I will continue to put forward specifics on issues of real concern to this district and, at the same time, I hope Hillary will discard the false advertising and level with voters.
As always, never hesitate to [reach out](mailto:josh@paulhudsonforcongress.com).
Humbly, Paul

## Trump Unable to Secure Bond
Lawyers for former President Trump told a New York appellate court Monday that [he cannot secure](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb_G3ogw8MAMDF2ypWtH6wGPhAobREii_n2Vzh2v7hmOztdlu2Au-bh-4k5upLphGPlJm2SLZUJtao4uEQmSM7nFLHwFEArmm1uj58aSEkGYJShC8JYDWCPX4INNc3aCC8XlYrkFDfpkjdcprFElQNJcTopTzKP203fNx7hRKj_1Sf0U6j4Xdxuj3Sf5MYnzJM7YDnrd39d79JFDoUmcR3_sjaWOj8h8PSLD1ggL23MpuR7MACVJyYM3PGpCJT3hCl5DSmZd-NxdbK83fNdmUvy6Yy5_AuPfHL8BAAD__4smYJw) a $454 million bond to appeal his civil fraud judgment. Trump's lawyers have also asked the [court to reverse](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLuOwyAURL8Gd1iYl01BsY27bLulhc0luREYC0is_P3KW2830mikOefnttwcRtzv3y6BbSEvbmv4hkXQwVAuF9l5GwA4iA7sMA5sUopL1T2s4uCMDpMemRKB83UQwbApeCHNMG6-Q8sZl0wMhhmlle7NuOqwTV4G5UAzQSQDjy2X_plxbw8I8ZPfUPotpy7aR2tHJeKL8Jnw-TzPflvrDme9esLnKxI-t_JKR6XRnR8olUotacIYMe80FPfy9Pny9wR7o0e54DYXKaYj14orRmwfwueuWH-c16rqkUh2Tw7j3432r5TfAAAA__9Qr2VQ) the requirement for the bond and halt the ruling's enforcement. To obtain a bond, Trump would have to post collateral covering 120% of the judgment, or about $557.5 million. Trump officials said they [approached more than 30](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ8GOiJYFhMXFF_jLl97pUXMEnPiJzIkUd7-lKuvntEU83VZLz7lVG__fSE3Ylv9NtKTVi3ULABX5MFFIiDNySmr5NkYQMN3F4LRWsdglQ8apVERN6u0DegBpAGeHEhAqdUsZzOZ6TTb6xS3c8BoPE1SM5QU0mjH6bulOnaK-d2edJy2Vnh2-xj3zvQ_BguDZey0p5w_jMFS6dUzjUFHZ7BcHz1V6l3Q1morbwYLGpRqlmIcj3LvorRKb_Fq9NH54cL9lXJOfbIM5a349Bvm488FPwEAAP__3w5dDw) bond companies and found none to handle that amount. In addition, bond companies only accept cash or cash equivalents, and Trump's wealth is tied up in real estate. If the court [doesn't reverse](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb_G3ogw8MAMDF2ypWtH6wGPhAobREii_n2Vzh2v7hmOztdlu2Au-bh-4k5upLphGPlJm2SLZUJtao4uEQmSM7nFLHwFEArmm1uj58aSEkGYJShC8JYDWCPX4INNc3aCC8XlYrkFDfpkjdcprFElQNJcTopTzKP203fNx7hRKj_1Sf0U6j4Xdxuj3Sf5MYnzJM7YDnrd39d79JFDoUmcR3_sjaWOj8h8PSLD1ggL23MpuR7MACVJyYM3PGpCJT3hCl5DSmZd-NxdbK83fNdmUvy6Yy5_AuPfHL8BAAD__4smYJw) the requirement, the state can begin seizing Trump's assets on March 25.
## Supreme Court Blocks Texas Law
The Supreme Court on Monday [barred Texas from implementing a law](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L-upCAUgPGnwU6DB1ApLLaxm223NKwc9Ez4Y4AZZt9-k3vb23_Fl9-fx_4w5Cmev03Atbq0m6PSG3fRj7oHucvOrg4RUHS4jvPIF6VAqu5arTV2nrmQ3EizWBQzCNRuUto5LTjvaAUOkotRc60mNQ16_ju5Y7HSKYMTF0xytFRTHp6JYr3Q-X_pjXk4Uuj8etV6FyZ-MdgYbK21oZlyUTxrivgxgeJ3ymCL2AqD7fkqlQ5ksIGGaVGKwVZed8aA_ZFeufZ3xjfGWvqKH1N6CoHObCql2HvTGGxdXu3dyHsq08wkP4Mh_zVUf-T5HwAA__96lmhR) that would have allowed the state to arrest illegal immigrants without the federal government being involved. The court ruled that a temporary hold on the law should continue while the case is reviewed by the 5th Circuit Court of Appeals in April. At issue is whether the law unconstitutionally conflicts with federal immigration authority. A federal judge [temporarily blocked the law on March 4,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1vwyAUAH8NbLbw8wPMwNDFW7p2tPh4xFTYRDaN1X9fpXPWO-mk-7otN5dL3u-fbiPbUl1caPlJy9gNpgNckEebiIBGTnbQg5ikBJR8tWaQMmDywhNMILRDL8AnVAEnAoE8WxCAYhyMMFJJ1RvtVQpTxCQdKTEyFBRzq0f_XfPeVkrltz7p6EPdeLFra4-TjR8MZgbzdV299-HlGMw7XecL1qPE7ufsgttddJ2apNFaAj9sfFy5lHwqzVDcN5fLf7a9nfwLAAD__zUaUWU) and the 5th Circuit paused that ruling, leading the Biden administration to file its emergency request to the Supreme Court requesting Monday's continuation of the block.
## List: The Oldest Hotel in Every U.S. State
It's Travel Tuesday at the Flyover, and if you're in the mood for a tour of America's most historic hotels, here's a list of [the oldest hotels in every state](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9ugzAQgPGnMZuRff5DGDx0YUvXjsiJz-DqgiNzDeXtq3bu_kmf9Pu4ztdYqGzLe3xg4FzneOfywtlIPUqws-1SyIiApsOgB60uzoF13RoSKK2dH7IxYKzS1sY03EZnkjcZAboSQIFVRo9qdN75fhxuPt8vyWYX0SsjrMJUuLb-s5aNV8x01he2_l4fHYWV-bkL8yZgEjAdx9FTfSF-P6m2si2_lYBpiUTYTio7C5i01aN3AiZeUVZKuLNcKyPJssmzfjW5c2TsWkjPoxCV3Q_CquURC_1t-V-EnwAAAP__YXxd8w) in America. The list ranges from the colonial era, such as the 1716 Wayside Inn in Sudbury, Mass., to the revolutionary era's Maryland Inn in Annapolis, through to the relatively modern Argo Hotel, opened in 1912 in Crofton, Nebraska. The hotels included in the list are still operating and open for business. You can find the oldest hotel in your state at the link above, along with photos.

body:
You've likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7def75b7889844608a24b35cb4677662&_e=RPc5uRTHumbkmqRfHs6Mr-I9L5qYSEr2sIhe4XaOozcjTSr21NuTklQthuUuXMbkBO-MYDDUtwioABfN96ta5ZC2zEETMzgC1mS34kdL-kVE58LyVmAaZGlK6D9Ie2T1J2Q-4-BBPqrv7uKk2v0C--2p4iQ8br_iA3670f7PIaH7Xu2vwUKD207InjapMdFa-aRS-6Cf3m7kJ_WYkz5imONh2YfHz9XLPpZANpu_i6C3vthHeaCGUag3CVoXjhvEoPM--RO0EsUkzXvKJmkf6R8fSoPb28-UoOlMFvF6Y1IKrHIbWa3aDjF_wOM7q4QLI0r12-xjCCyKNhUXyy2q6q_0ved6xDc_maT8uB_F7Y24I7q-OxQyRrIt9gOrEyAoeJXv7b0b46lRnf2acqH6C1F5iYk5uBvvrRuhPtVsZkM%3D)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, "The Constitution is kind of trash." That's what a guest--with an Ivy League degree--said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You've likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like "The Constitution is kind of trash." And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as "the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written." And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we're serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn't run from them. We should embrace them. **That 's why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course, ["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7def75b7889844608a24b35cb4677662&_e=RPc5uRTHumbkmqRfHs6Mr-I9L5qYSEr2sIhe4XaOozcjTSr21NuTklQthuUuXMbkBO-MYDDUtwioABfN96ta5ZC2zEETMzgC1mS34kdL-kVE58LyVmAaZGlK6D9Ie2T1J2Q-4-BBPqrv7uKk2v0C--2p4iQ8br_iA3670f7PIaH7Xu2vwUKD207InjapMdFa-aRS-6Cf3m7kJ_WYkz5imONh2YfHz9XLPpZANpu_i6C3vthHeaCGUag3CVoXjhvEoPM--RO0EsUkzXvKJmkf6RpJjENq3EyPdDbBy_QfUJZ5ThtCs0AdwFIqPKWxwM6zlIEWW8un71G25ZS_-RQ4ZNu-c5sJPfUkCjs4-kVPKlbel039Mu5h_75lffQziX0k8EbXR4aYC6ppaGd574871bykI-O-yA0KABTHlVjbxn8%3D)**** on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

Hillsdale's faculty teach the course, and it will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. These DVDs also make a great gift for someone unfamiliar with our nation's founding principles--maybe even a friend or family member. But supplies are limited. So, be sure to get this special edition of _**" The Federalist Papers"**_ on DVD today. More than 200,000 people have already taken this course, so this DVD box set won't last long. | | Dear Fellow American, "The Constitution is kind of trash." That's what a guest--with an Ivy League degree--said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You've likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like "The Constitution is kind of trash." And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as "the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written." And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we're serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn't run from them. We should embrace them. **That 's why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course, ["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fd53b4857c6140968eccda951a74b6cb&_e=yYYFAlmXIQuX9u68Q9K7oajrqTjmctRrh7napjH38dq_oFgVH5uZSmt7lgqXJ-nqpbdHe6sX2TqBb-r0ove2XGy68ahR2sdKSM-pJcVMHgdaU1wUnXdnP3up2ogV0SvFb4Zi5puTyilrxsdo3T2h9aTA8BOyBOJbEDCCpeEUeK0NX8BKoLDRS16BjHPiXLKU36iinkGd2JvL5qsZFIFvaigugDA43BPA_xA-DfIQlurHgBl95QuxOLUg-SmLRQONLEjTXjqbY8pkjQIKuDfBa9Mz9Ci-KjtbBjsSXbGjtI0vv82Qfk00YDIDSh2huUdPH5fnT5c6gDwAUuHYFEydbRW1onWy_so_TWqfwW7NTE6ZuykcHxBbSQ4RMkW1KV70LSNp112xoQquk15UpLhpIx_yAOM6iaq-VbBGz8BpvfY%3D)**** on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: The Power of the Cross
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsrG5RBiCN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osrG5RBiCN

Hello
Friend,

The cross
of Jesus Christ stands at the center of our faith. It is the
symbol not just of a religion but of the ultimate sacrifice and
love displayed by Jesus Christ for humanity.

The cross
stands as a reminder of the immense love of God, who sent His
only Son to bear the burden of our sins. Through His sacrifice,
Jesus provided a path to redemption and eternal life for all who
believe in Him.

In
moments of hardship and uncertainty, we, as believers, can find
strength in the shadow of the cross. It stands as a promise of
salvation and the assurance of God's unfailing grace.

The power
of the cross lies in its ability to transform lives and reconcile
humanity with God. It is the ultimate symbol of victory-victory
over sin and death. It offers forgiveness and restoration to all
who embrace its message.

This
beautiful full-color 96-page large print "coffee-table style"
book is filled with imagery from the Holy Land as well as
photographic depictions of key Scriptural events. It can be used
as a daily devotional or as a timeless reference resource about
the events of Jesus' final week on earth.

A copy of
The Power of the Cross is our gift to anyone who supports the
ministry of Pathway to Victory. By making a secure, generous
donation to our work of evangelism and Bible teaching, you are
helping many people around the world experience the power of the
cross and its message of hope and forgiveness.

Please consider
supporting our mission of helping people know Jesus and
understand the Bible. If you can help, here is a link to make
your secure donation and order your copy of The Power of the
Cross: https://secure.ptv.org/the_power_of_the_cross

Our time for sharing
the message of Jesus and the power of the cross grows shorter
every day.

Let's make the most
of it by partnering together!

Sincerely,

Dr. Robert Jeffress
Senior Pastor, First
Baptist Dallas

| | | Dear Peter,

Today is the day - It is Primary Election Day! All precinct polling places will be open.

Many Republicans running in various races are unopposed, me included. Even so, we still need your vote. So, pull a Republican ballot at the polls today and vote for all Republican candidates.

A text message has been circulating that appears to be sent from the Conforti for Congress campaign encouraging you to pull a democrat ballot and vote for Mahnoor Ahmad. This is a False Flag! We would never tell you to vote democrat - for many reasons.

So, get out to vote today, pull a Republican ballot, and vote Niki Conforti for US Congressional District 6!

The race to the General Election on November 5th starts NOW!

Stay Safe! Stay Strong!

Can you help support the Conforti for Congress campaign's efforts to beat Casten? Your contribution will go a long way in helping us win! You can click the link below to make a donation today.

Your support is greatly appreciated.

| Thank you,

Niki Conforti

Dear Peter,
I recently had the opportunity to discuss President Biden’s competency on national television.
It goes without saying, the stakes are incredibly high.
Our children's future hangs on the decisions made during those critical 3:00 AM calls. We must have confidence in a president who can rise to the occasion, who is sharp and alert – even in the dead of night – considering the weighty matters that affect our nation.
President Biden must step forward and demonstrate to the American people that he possesses the cognitive ability and mental clarity required for this demanding role, especially during what may be one of the most challenging times in recent American history.
We're facing existential challenges. We’re engaged in multiple wars and confronting dire economic calamities. The middle class is disappearing, with 57% of Americans unable to access $1,000 in an emergency. An entire generation is struggling to afford homes.
This is nothing short of a crisis. We need a president who not only recognizes these pressing issues but also is able to articulate viable solutions to the American people.
Again, our children's futures hang in the balance, and we need assurance that our president is equipped to confront these challenges head-on, even in the darkest hours of the night.
America is in desperate need of honest leadership – the kind that comes from a rigorous leader able and willing to make hard choices to lead our nation through turbulent times.
Together, we can tackle the challenges ahead and build an America full of economic promise. An America that is healthier, more free, and embraces our best qualities.
Because of your support, this is now the most successful independent campaign in history. _Can I count on you now to go the distance with me?_
[Our goal is to raise $4 million before the end of the month FEC report is due. It is absolutely attainable with 100% participation from friends like you.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-policies-video?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_comp_3_19_24_rs_nd3&n=5)

subject: Officer of the Year
body:
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm46pfnaesun204mpf1c047fpd73pqi1itmqmbp8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c3hmao71c5h2bs)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zonthiiqirfkk665d6ekuqofo3egchcho15l2lf8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c3hmao71c5h2bs)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zs40p290r400kaag8o4sh5sdnga7v6or5viqg428_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c3hmao71c5h2bs)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7dljroehvq46o30us47no27eifg5cekaahnfm18_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c3hmao71c5h2bs)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zi4rv7cderlit9lvmj3n3rs95q4sghnrb7ht7lho_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c3hmao71c5h2bs)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note-maybe a prayer?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zosbmm1nhq1sj4bjs7bmph2eraneafbsauh8ch7o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c3hmao71c5h2bs)** There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: New poll in Michigan Senate race
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1240%2E135344%2EehbfRi)
Breaking news: **A new, independent poll shows that the Senate race in Michigan is a statistical dead-heat.** While some may think Michigan is solidly blue, this poll shows we need to be doing everything we can right now to set us up for success on Election Day.
Today, I wanted to pull back the curtain and explain what else was in this poll, and what it means for our campaign.
[**Before I dive in, I would love it if you would consider chipping in $3 or more to help us defend this open Senate seat in Michigan. In light of this poll, we need to show grassroots strength as national Republicans size up our ability to win.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240319-1-700&t=2&akid=1240%2E135344%2EehbfRi)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240319-1-700&t=3&akid=1240%2E135344%2EehbfRi)**
There are a few important numbers in this poll that tell us a lot about how we need to continue running our campaign: Despite this race being a statistical tie, 23% of voters are undecided. Those are the people who will decide our election – and who we need to take our message to.
Another key statistic from this poll: 51% of voters say they haven’t heard of me yet. We’ve been doing everything we can to take our message directly to voters early by visiting cities and towns all over Michigan and meeting with folks to talk about the issues that matter to them. But this poll reminds us how big the state of Michigan is (11 media markets!) and makes it clear just how critical that initial introduction is.
This poll also shows that the presidential election will likely be decided in Michigan, and right now former President Trump is leading President Biden 45-41. National Republicans view Michigan as a key battleground state for both the presidential race and the Senate, which is why we’ve already seen three visits from Trump, and why we can expect to see even more.
[**In a race this tight, every dollar truly makes the difference, which is why I am asking: Will you donate any amount now to help build our war chest and set our campaign up for success in this race?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240319-1-700&t=4&akid=1240%2E135344%2EehbfRi)

# [Sign: If Trump won't pay the $454 million he owes, seize his assets, and put him in jail](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcca7e379-60a5-4250-a8b5-25c03a060136/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Donald Trump owes $454 million from his NY civil fraud case, and he's not paying it. The guy who said he was worth "TEN BILLION DOLLARS" and has property all around the world suddenly can't pay what he owes – and is trying to delay the deadline endlessly. [**Tell the Trump judges not to give Trump more time, and to seize his assets and put Trump in jail if he won't pay.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T736ae4a8-eb57-45b3-bc37-44d3675adbd1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump's attorneys are claiming that 30 different entities have refused to back a bond for the sum. Is it any wonder that the guy who famously doesn't pay his bills can't get someone to lend him money? Trump is trying to appeal the decision, asking the court to pause the $454 million judgment or accept only a $100 million bond. No way! Anyone else in this position would be forced to pay, and to sell assets to get the money, and Trump should not get special treatment. Trump has boasted of his wealth for decades and it's time for him to pay up. If he doesn't have the cash, the courts can and should start freezing his bank accounts and seizing his properties. [**Sign your name to tell the courts: Don't give Trump any more time, make him pay up now!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tec5895c3-d6bb-477a-af03-026c04240605/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Friends,
Systematic attempts to unravel our democracy are happening right now across the country — one that isn’t getting enough attention is ballot initiatives that take power away from voters.
**Our team is tracking critical ballot initiatives in half a dozen states right now, but we want to give you an update about two that will be before voters this November:**
* In Arizona, voters will be deciding on a measure that would amend the state constitution to require signatures for ballot initiatives to be gathered from each legislative district as opposed to the current requirement of signatures from 15 percent of registered voters from the state at-large.
* In North Dakota, voters will be deciding a measure that would institute a single subject requirement on ballot initiatives, increase the statewide signature gathering requirement to 5 percent from 4 percent of voters, and require approval in a primary and general election for any proposal that

**Yes, the details of these proposals are a bit confusing, because that’s exactly what the opposition wants — to confuse voters. But let’s be clear: When you unpack these proposals, they’re direct efforts to make it harder for citizens to engage in direct democracy and hold politicians accountable.**

# Illegal Immigration:
### Can it get much worse?
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/redirect/45b73ff3-441b-4bec-9f74-4a86ff4686d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| Mar 19
---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/45b73ff3-441b-4bec-9f74-4a86ff4686d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
The severity of the crisis at our Southern Border has reached unprecedented levels, and it appears the Biden Administration either remains oblivious with their heads in the sand, or, more alarmingly, they are fully aware of the situation and simply do not care. You don't have to look far to see the results of the federal government's failure to address this national security and economic crisis: the Border Patrol reported 250,000 migrant encounters last December, the highest recorded monthly total in the history of the country. And the Biden Administration admitted to flying more than 300,000 illegal immigrants into the country to reduce the numbers at the border. Simply put, the Biden Administration and the federal government have failed the American people, forcing the states to handle the crisis alone. **(This is one of many reasons we need Donald Trump to win in November)** Because of the federal government's inaction, some states like Texas are having to take action on their Southern Border, with support from other conservative states like Mississippi. But right now, there are bills pending in the Mississippi Legislature that might make the problem of illegal immigration even worse. Senate Bill 2145 and House Bill 728 are currently active in our Mississippi Legislature--and these bills create a dangerous backdoor for taxpayer-funded health care for illegal immigrants. This legislation is aimed at strengthening the 340B prescription drug discount program--but that can be misused by health care providers to subsidize health care benefits for illegal aliens. As Mississippians, it is our responsibility to take a stand and ensure that these bills do not become law. In a document from the Community Health Care Association of New York that was recently uncovered by a Real Clear Politics Reporter, it specifically states that Community Health Centers there rely on the 340B drug discount program helps them by "Subsidizing costs of care for undocumented" people in their state. Why should illegal immigrants receive free health care when so many hard-working Americans struggle with the challenge of paying their mortgage, rent, groceries, and even their own healthcare? Mississippi conservatives do NOT support taxpayer-funded health care for illegal immigrants. I won't stand for this, and neither should you. The good news is, there's still time to stop SB 2145 and HB 728--but you need to make your voice heard and contact your Mississippi Legislator to ask them to oppose this legislation. Call them today while there is still time!
Dan Carr

Monday is a BIG day for my U.S. Senate campaign. On Monday I’m meeting with my campaign team to establish our budget for the campaign from April 15 to June 18, which is the date of my primary election. I’ve been working hard since we announced this campaign almost one year ago. It is truly an honor to be a candidate for the United States Senate and to have the opportunity to run against Tim Kaine. Fundraising is the hardest part of being a candidate. I must ask my family, friends, and total strangers to make a financial contribution to support me during a very challenging economic situation for so many of you – and it’s not even tax deductible! You all know I’m not wealthy, but at the beginning of the race Cortlynn and I contributed $13,200 – which is the maximum for federal contributions – because I wanted to be able to tell anyone else that I was asking money from that I have skin in the game. subject: Huge victory for families!
body:
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YVUVvehiiKAcfC0Kp94igIuRWN2hastPWCsCcVin2faLNx-nWn654mcZlT_FqtLeykW0fEPA-94vgR9F8DehbnOFJ4GpjAyflI_UPLfH1d-fo38Z6V3xTiZK89GFEz_orF0Tynd9_QP-es8uxSzXLPt95SaouTgljhWpcDZM3cw6wXWJsaN6Ds66YhGpUQafRKroIca4RPlZdt8bxP5tMeTrhmn10aOS&c=QOmAExiNvh_v4rWSR7HWTx0BBCM_X-kFf5RpHytlBpPTgXKzl8Zn6Q==&ch=TjcWHKiT7YbugTPF9d3dAdSL_AI3gEz1u5CGD8hzQIcDSz8D15xWrQ==)
---
Greetings!
For decades, the porn industry has intentionally targeted children completely unchecked by politicians, and finally parents said enough was enough.
At APP, our goal has centered around making the American family a priority in our laws and elections by focusing on issues that impact millions of parents which have been ignored by our politicians. Over the last few years we have worked tirelessly with state legislators and activists across the country to educate and introduce legislation that would protect children online from obscene content, and this past week we received more exciting news!
Last week, Indiana Governor Eric Holcomb signed legislation into law that requires websites that publish pornographic content to use 'reasonable age verification methods.' This means we have now seen a form of [age-verification legislation passed in nine states](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YVUVvehiiKAcfC0Kp94igIuRWN2hastPWCsCcVin2faLNx-nWn654mcZlT_FqtLeykW0fEPA-94vgR9F8DehbnOFJ4GpjAyflI_UPLfH1d-fo38Z6V3xTiZK89GFEz_orF0Tynd9_QP-es8uxSzXLPt95SaouTgljhWpcDZM3cw6wXWJsaN6Ds66YhGpUQafRKroIca4RPlZdt8bxP5tMeTrhmn10aOS&c=QOmAExiNvh_v4rWSR7HWTx0BBCM_X-kFf5RpHytlBpPTgXKzl8Zn6Q==&ch=TjcWHKiT7YbugTPF9d3dAdSL_AI3gEz1u5CGD8hzQIcDSz8D15xWrQ==), with more on the way!
---
| Also, one of the leading online producers of adult content, PornHub, just announced they will be restricting access to the state of Texas in response to their age-verification law passed last year.
In their statement to users PornHub said:
"We call on all adult sites to comply with the law. Until the real solution is offered, we have made the difficult decision to completely disable access to our website in Texas. In doing so, we are complying with the law, as we always do, but hope the governments around the world will implement laws that actually protect the safety and security of users."
This is huge! For decades we were told from politicians and activists there was "nothing we could do" to protect children online. That's no longer the case.

Happy Women’s History Month, Peter!

My name is Katherine Clark, and I proudly serve Massachusetts’ 5th district in Congress. I am also in House leadership serving as the Democratic Whip.

It wasn’t too long ago when there were hardly any women serving in Congress at all. When I first came to Congress in 2013, I was stopped and mistaken for someone’s spouse (multiple times), making it difficult to even get into the Chamber to cast a vote.

Fast forward to today, and thankfully, things have improved. **There are more women serving in Congress than ever before — 94 women in the House Democratic Caucus alone!**

I’ve been adamant about bringing more women into Congress because the truth is that for generations, we’ve failed to address the persistent challenges faced by women, especially by women of color.

| The future of IVF across the country has been turned upside down since the Alabama Supreme Court’s latest attack on reproductive rights.

Peter, I didn’t grow up with power or privilege.
I was born and raised in a working-class family in one of Brooklyn’s many diverse neighborhoods. Throughout my entire childhood and into my young adulthood, I had no real platform to voice my opinions or speak out against the decisions that were _directly_ affecting me and my family.
So when I made history in 2018 by becoming the first Black lawmaker ever to serve as New York’s attorney general, I vowed that – _no matter what_ – I would be a voice for the voiceless and speak for those who had been silenced for so long.
**I’m proud to say that I’ve kept that promise – and this Priorities Survey is a key part of keeping it to this day.**

I listened to people's top concerns and devoted myself to going toe-to-toe with anti-abortion extremists, taking on the gun lobby, and fighting against a record number of LGBTQ+ hate and discrimination efforts.

Last week’s passage of Senate Bill 233 - the school voucher scam that Republican politicians cooked up to defund our public education system and pad the pockets of their rich friends - is a somber reminder that taking a Democratic Majority in the State House is the _best_ way we can fight back against their extreme agenda. **The radical Republican trifecta that has failed Georgians will continue to go unchecked unless we keep up our fight against their bad bills.** Here’s just a taste of what’s heading our way: **The so-called “Religious Freedom Restoration Act” (RFRA).** This bill makes it legal to discriminate against LGBTQ+ Georgians – as well as women, religious minorities and other vulnerable communities – by denying them business services or even housing using religious beliefs as a pretext. **Book Bans.** Another bill subjects school librarians to criminal charges for allowing books with “sexual” content to be checked out; it also requires schools to send an email to parents every time a student checks out a book. If you’re as appalled as we are, please help us keep fighting. The radical Republican trifecta that has failed Georgians will continue to go unchecked unless we keep up our fight against their bad bills. Here’s just a taste of what’s heading our way: The so-called “Religious Freedom Restoration Act” (RFRA). This bill makes it legal to discriminate against LGBTQ+ Georgians – as well as women, religious minorities and other vulnerable communities – by denying them business services or even housing using religious beliefs as a pretext. Book Bans. Foreign nations have been taking tax dollars from us for YEARS.

It's time to ask foreign nations: **Is this a friendship, or are you using us?**

****I can tell you right now foreign nations are using us. I don 't know about you, but I think American tax dollars should be used for Americans.****
| [**PUT AMERICA FIRST**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=98c9ee2c3a994f5d82195d329240ee2f&_e=TSJC_1DO0ISjAJyEs1w34PXmISuJz8dsJNljP53TqsC04-32l1PJX6eMtSVSl4NC1bx3ykUNd8iyqdo7jGXpcyYuLNGr8V7JAUX-LlY19hk75IeEWPDyIEiNJcr6oi4XgmZHkXZ9LLMzi06mmPZHy3hz78rXgnIGwqGSilNHpn_SpyzKIbkEaWrdXcGPps8Ciq41fdJqeA2aC0d2sdtweidLfGOQlvBCPTRtfGmkEOvWOqcSRhLQzUDYBkAWFcUXIp4fg97ipXgEcgl-ho-nXlozxaCKCOufJDEwH74-cRz8VHIAZMQQs8d-fnKfq7p2BDGjr1llQvoMxq4mGKasMgAsWPV9GxeqFaFMt0_e1Ohic5MK7xxYiEXab33XUbkPjtvg7kYXTTdmFJ5a5iL9-g%3D%3D)

For years, foreign nations have depended on the US for support. In Ukraine, we're paying for pensions and subsidizing small businesses. Even worse, our European "allies" have used us as a crutch for eighty years, refusing to pay their share of the bill for defense. This is not an example of allied nations but client states.

****How can America protect itself if our allies can 't defend themselves?****
[**PROTECT AMERICA**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=98c9ee2c3a994f5d82195d329240ee2f&_e=TSJC_1DO0ISjAJyEs1w34PXmISuJz8dsJNljP53TqsC04-32l1PJX6eMtSVSl4NC1bx3ykUNd8iyqdo7jGXpcyYuLNGr8V7JAUX-LlY19hk75IeEWPDyIEiNJcr6oi4XgmZHkXZ9LLMzi06mmPZHy3hz78rXgnIGwqGSilNHpn_SpyzKIbkEaWrdXcGPps8Ciq41fdJqeA2aC0d2sdtweidLfGOQlvBCPTRtfGmkEOvWOqcSRhLQzUDYBkAWFcUXxsfRc8DNUj-LtN0J3No5KDQICrp3tPQriN9vIxndU4DaVQbxtjk_2iG8eiHCz0Afev21k3iYhVTeyyUT3RgxQ03me6__reEnL6PRYNPcrsuu5BXR8qSd1IE0IlqHjyOCw3Zh-WOVXu7iA2jJMPrPfQ%3D%3D)

Americans have paid an additional tax for YEARS to defend other countries. This shouldn't happen when we are facing an INVASION at our own border.

Sending money overseas has WEAKENED our military. We simply can't make enough of the weapons we would need to win - or better yet prevent - a major war.

****It 's time for our allies, especially Europe, to stand on their own two feet.****
[**STOP SENDING MY TAX DOLLARS OVERSEAS**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=98c9ee2c3a994f5d82195d329240ee2f&_e=TSJC_1DO0ISjAJyEs1w34PXmISuJz8dsJNljP53TqsC04-32l1PJX6eMtSVSl4NC1bx3ykUNd8iyqdo7jGXpcyYuLNGr8V7JAUX-LlY19hk75IeEWPDyIEiNJcr6oi4XgmZHkXZ9LLMzi06mmPZHy3hz78rXgnIGwqGSilNHpn_SpyzKIbkEaWrdXcGPps8Ciq41fdJqeA2aC0d2sdtweidLfGOQlvBCPTRtfGmkEOvWOqcSRhLQzUDYBkAWFcUX6uAS-JvTtmXHs6UlTN7Xi2kzvpaSALuMPLnKNt7hn7kQmM9SnzZldzK_7743etcAaIF9GvxyOCZmPt00Z68jDRD--2K3Dxz00ah6HYnO9wVTChbuEirZHhpMGTyFPK6TkryNWHCqYEEaf7Ilq1EGuw%3D%3D)

We don't have time or money to support other countries who won't hold up their half of the deal. It's time to tackle rising crime, illegal immigrants swarming our nation, and the fentanyl epidemic instead.

****We need to look in the mirror and realize we 've got a lot more going on here at home than we thought.****

Today is Primary Election Day in Ohio, which means we’ll soon learn who our Republican opponent will be. **Before that, though, I wanted to remind you what we’re up against.**

Over the past few months, my team has kept you updated on how this race is already shaping up to be **one of the most competitive in the country.** → National Republicans have added me to their list of top targets for this November.

→ Jim Jordan has endorsed one of my primary opponents.

→ And multiple election forecasters have named this seat **a pure TOSS-UP.** So let me be clear about one thing: Whoever wins this primary will be the recipient of hordes of outside cash from Republican mega donors and super PACs.

That means the fight to defend OH-13 is only just getting started.

body:
| I was elected as the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2249%2E35263%2Eb1UHXS)
Peter — When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service, but I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly. Seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love — I came to realize that I could do both. I could run for office and be honest about who I am. [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-mar24.lt590f&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240319_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2249%2E35263%2Eb1UHXS) Thanks to the support of this incredible team, **I was elected as the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.** I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that. **That’s why I first ran for office — not to make history, but to make a difference.** And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too. We’ve made incredible progress, but we cannot mistake our progress for victory. Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, especially targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ+ youth. A Republican Senate majority threatens to do the same at the national level. It’s going to take all of us to counter these right-wing attacks so everyone grows up knowing they belong — and that kindness and inclusion, not hatred and division, are American values. So, as my opponent and Republicans nationwide threaten to advance an extreme and hateful agenda, I'm asking you again: **[Will you help me fight back against the far-right extremists trying to undo our progress? Pitch into my reelection campaign today, and let’s keep making a difference together.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-mar24.lt590f&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240319_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=2249%2E35263%2Eb1UHXS)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $5 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2150?c0=tbe-em-mar24.B96yhC&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240319_AM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=2249%2E35263%2Eb1UHXS)
