clean_body: | I was elected as the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. Peter — When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service, but I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly. Seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love — I came to realize that I could do both. I could run for office and be honest about who I am. Thanks to the support of this incredible team, I was elected as the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the Respect for Marriage Act , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that. That’s why I first ran for office — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too. We’ve made incredible progress, but we cannot mistake our progress for victory. Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, especially targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ+ youth. A Republican Senate majority threatens to do the same at the national level. It’s going to take all of us to counter these right-wing attacks so everyone grows up knowing they belong — and that kindness and inclusion, not hatred and division, are American values. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81266942/461902015/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmU1NWZlNjItMWFlNi1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_k-mAI2eo8s3-G539w8AvIGMM3E8PqxZVzoNJPRDfAk=&emci=c777e95c-1ae6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=be55fe62-1ae6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=14016711)
Hey Peter,
You’ve probably heard by now that Donald Trump promised a “blood bath” at a rally over the weekend if he loses in 2024.
The comment has drawn intense media coverage, even for Trump. Here are just a few headlines from recent days:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81266943/461902018/-593472309?refcode=20240319-EM-TrumpCoverage&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmU1NWZlNjItMWFlNi1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_k-mAI2eo8s3-G539w8AvIGMM3E8PqxZVzoNJPRDfAk=)
Let’s be clear – Trump is irresponsibly using violent rhetoric here, but is that anything new?
As President, Trump tweeted “when the looting starts, the shooting starts” in the wake of the George Floyd protests. In the hours before the January 6th riot, he told supporters to march to the Capitol, adding “you’ll never take our country back with weakness.”

| **Los Banos Councilwoman Deborah Lewis Endorses John Duarte for Congress**
---
| | **Modesto **— Today, John Duarte announces an endorsement from Los Banos City Councilwoman Deborah Lewis. During her endorsement, Councilwoman Deborah Lewis highlighted Duarte’s bipartisan approach and record of putting politics aside to find real solutions to the Valley.

“I fully endorse John Duarte’s re-election campaign to Congress. Time and again, Duarte has shown that he will stand up for the Valley and fight to bring real solutions to our communities. We need leaders like him in Washington who will work to build a brighter future for Valley and Los Banos residents.”

John Duarte responded to the endorsement, saying, “I am grateful for the continued support my campaign has received across the Valley from community leaders like Councilwoman Lewis. Right now, working families are struggling and need results now. My mission is to continue to work across the aisle to lower our cost of living, keep our communities safe, and get our economy back on track.”

John Duarte’s campaign continues to gain momentum as community leaders like Councilwoman Lewis add their names to a growing list of supporters endorsing his campaign. For more information about John Duarte or the campaign, please visit [www.johnduarteforcongress.com](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=7e92f004bf&e=76a47b375f). ###

Time and again, Duarte has shown that he will stand up for the Valley and fight to bring real solutions to our communities. We need leaders like him in Washington who will work to build a brighter future for Valley and Los Banos residents.” John Duarte responded to the endorsement, saying, “I am grateful for the continued support my campaign has received across the Valley from community leaders like Councilwoman Lewis. Right now, working families are struggling and need results now. My mission is to continue to work across the aisle to lower our cost of living, keep our communities safe, and get our economy back on track.” John Duarte’s campaign continues to gain momentum as community leaders like Councilwoman Lewis add their names to a growing list of supporters endorsing his campaign. | | BETTY YEE
---
| |

| | "Dom Jones' compelling personal journey of struggles and triumphs has inspired her leadership serving her community and as a businesswoman. She will be an inclusive representative for the people and businesses in the 72nd Assembly District."Former California State Controller Betty Yee

| | Note for our Readers: To the Dom Jones team, endorsements are not mere stamps of approval; they symbolize the profound confidence our elected leaders have in Dom Jones to lead with fairness, decisiveness, care, and unwavering support for every member of the community. Dom Jones very consciously accepts endorsements from individuals who inspire and uplift all people, recognizing this as a testament to the beauty of democracy. We are deeply honored by the support of Betty Yee and look forward to continuing our journey towards the win on Nov.5th 2024!

body:
#
Big news, friends!
**Power to the Polls — the organization Mandela heads up — just passed a huge milestone! They’ve knocked on over 50,000 doors in Wisconsin!**
With some of the biggest elections in our nation's history upcoming, Mandela is leading the charge with Power to the Polls to fundamentally change the way we organize in Black, Brown, and working-class communities —ensuring that communities that are too often left behind finally have a voice. Now we are asking if you’ll step up to help too.
**[Can you please split a $5 contribution between Power to The Polls Wisconsin and The Long Run today to help fuel mobilization efforts in Wisconsin?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-power2thepolls-split.vXbZtT&refcode=em240319-1-tt&t=1&akid=5245%2E196590%2E1A1Vha)
We know how critical Wisconsin’s results will be this November. Wisconsin is one of a handful of states that determined the outcome of the 2016 and 2020 presidential elections. And with voting rights and a woman's right to choose literally on the ballot, we all know what’s at stake.
So as Power to the Polls continues knocking on voters’ doors, showing up in the community to listen to voters’ concerns and empowering them to overcome efforts to suppress their vote and keep them from the ballot box.
**[Can you please split a $5 contribution or whatever you can afford between Power to the Polls and The Long Run today so they can continue mobilizing voters?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-power2thepolls-split.vXbZtT&refcode=em240319-1-tt&t=2&akid=5245%2E196590%2E1A1Vha)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will be split between Power to the Polls Wisconsin and The Long Run immediately:_
[Express Donate: $5](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1271?c0=longrunpac-em-power2thepolls-split.ADME7Q&amount=5&refcode=em240319-1-tt&t=21&akid=5245%2E196590%2E1A1Vha)
[Express Donate: $25](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1273?c0=longrunpac-em-power2thepolls-split.l1zvmy&refcode=em240319-1-tt&t=22&akid=5245%2E196590%2E1A1Vha)
[Express Donate: $50](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1274?c0=longrunpac-em-power2thepolls-split.0iRyiC&refcode=em240319-1-tt&t=23&akid=5245%2E196590%2E1A1Vha)
[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=longrunpac-em-power2thepolls-split.3owE8C&refcode=em240319-1-tt&t=24&akid=5245%2E196590%2E1A1Vha)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=longrunpac-em-power2thepolls-split.44g3gi&refcode=em240319-1-tt&t=25&akid=5245%2E196590%2E1A1Vha)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-power2thepolls-split.vXbZtT&refcode=em240319-1-tt&t=26&akid=5245%2E196590%2E1A1Vha)
When more people vote, we all win. And if we continue to work together to get out the vote, we can fundamentally change what representation looks like here in Wisconsin - and around the country.
Thank you for your support. Let’s do this!
The Team at the Long Run

name: Team Cornel West for President 2024
subject: Act now to get truth, justice, and LOVE on the state ballot in 2024.
body:
Share the love today and give our state the gift of more choices beyond the corporate duopoly.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ballot_access_email_1_paths&n=1)
---
## **Why Ballot Access Matters for Democracy**
---
### **Obtaining ballot access in each state for independent presidential candidates like Brother Cornel West offers voters stronger democratic solutions for a more stable future that serves us all.**
In a political system dominated by a corporate-owned duopoly that brazenly places profits over people and the planet, many of us are faced with the absurd "choice" between civil war and genocide. When fear and greed-fueled violence and hate are the only choices on offer, it is clearly time for the power of independent voices and unified communities to stand up on behalf of the universal human interests of TRUTH, JUSTICE, and LOVE.
---
_**Did you know?** _ _Every state requires independent candidates to meet unique requirements to be allowed alongside the corporate duopoly party candidates on the state election ballot. As a result, Dr. West will implement a variety of strategies to secure ballot access in all 50 states.___
---
Dr. Cornel West is committed to a 50-state strategy for Ballot Access in the 2024 Presidential election, aiming to ensure that voters in every state have the option to support independent voices. This strategy acknowledges the varied paths to the ballot across states, calling for active participation and support in different ways:
1. **Independent Candidacy** : In some states, Dr. West will appear as an independent candidate, requiring signature collection, community outreach, and volunteer efforts to secure ballot access. In some "pay for play" states, donations will be critical to gain ballot access as an independent.

****
2. **Alliance with Independent State Parties** : Dr. West will partner with like-minded independent parties in many states to amplify the campaign's voice and values, relying on petition signing, spreading the word, and volunteering.

3. **Justice For All Party Candidacy:** On January 31st, 2024, the campaign launched the Justice For All Party, a grassroots initiative designed to obtain ballot access and inspire community-driven change, emphasizing the importance of grassroots support.

---
---
|
---
|
## Why Dr. West?
**_Dr. West enters the 2024 Presidential contest_** _at a time in which he describes a national crisis of moral bankruptcy and spiritual obscenity driven by a derelict duopoly of both major parties that equally places profits over people and the planet._ He views it as his duty to deliver policy prescriptions incorporated by and for the people, instead of political parties beholden to corporations and special interest groups who feel no solidarity with poor and working-class people of all races, gender identities, and age groups. [Learn more about Dr. Cornel West's Policy Pillars](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/platform?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ballot_access_email_1_paths&n=2)
---
## 5 Steps to take NOW to ensure ballot access for Dr. West in your state:
1. **Find your state on the[Ballot Access Map at CornelWest2024.com](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/petitioning_launch?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ballot_access_email_1_paths&n=3)** to learn which strategy is underway in your state and discover the specific ways you can help.

2. **Register to Vote Now** : If you have not already registered, register to vote in your state. When registering to vote, register as a member with the party aligned with the campaign in your state, if applicable.

3. **Get Your Lawn Sign, Swag, and Flyers:[Visit the Cornel West for President merch store](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=sxSABYF2yFKLmjlawhS_a10tpmpna_SE_wWQJfDfMOXvAff9UGAH6wB-xTazEj1M&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ballot_access_email_1_paths&n=4) **to make sure your friends, family, and neighbors know they have more positive options that put people first. Show you have the courage to envision a future of truth, justice, and love for our children.

---
* * *
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/petitioning_launch?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ballot_access_email_1_paths&n=5 "Visit the Ballot Access Launch Center") [Visit the Ballot Access Launch Center](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/petitioning_launch?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ballot_access_email_1_paths&n=5)
---
## Your action today will ensure our state has stronger choices in 2024
Help us join the growing number of states who value independent voices and fresh ideas that help us work together to build a more cooperative and just world for our posterity. **Let's s****ummon the courage to reject cynicism and envision a stronger, more cooperative and civil democracy that works for all.**
---
## **Raise a Hand for TRUTH, LOVE, & JUSTICE: Please Donate Today**
Brother West does not accept corporate donations, relying on the heartfelt support of individual supporters to keep momentum behind this 50-state movement for ballot access. If you are able, raise your hand in solidarity today to give $24 toward this important effort to give voice to the silenced and uplift our fellow siblings everywhere. _****_

body:

We have a number of opportunities coming up over the next few weeks including opening our official campaign office on Saturday March 30th. If you can attend please sign up on our volunteer website below. We will be going out to knock on Democratic doors in Towson with the Angela Alsobrooks campaign after the event.

If you would like to get in touch with the campaign please email us back or get in touch with us using the number below.

Thank you again for your support!

\--

James Phillips
Organizing Director
Johnny O for Congress
410-870-9284

All Republicans, and all voters and citizens, can join us in for our FREE community town halls across the state.

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

| I’ve been in office a year now. I’ve not gone viral once–that’s by design. Every week that I show up to Washington, I bring all the energy I can muster to solve the biggest challenges facing our country, not gain the most likes on social media. I coined a phrase my first year: I’m bringing BORING back to Congress. Whether it’s pouring over reports from the Government Accountability Office or talking about FAA regulations, I’m here to do the work, the boring stuff.

As I settle in to watch floor speeches from my colleagues, at some point, it dawns on me...oh, this is not about problem-solving; this is about going viral later. Sometimes, I feel like the House of Representatives could actually have its own reality TV show–The Real House Members of Washington, DC.

The Congressional obsession with social media over solving problems doesn’t affect everyone. I have great colleagues on both sides of the aisle who are there to do the work, but there are fewer and fewer of us.

I continue to show up to do the work–supporting working families, championing our small businesses and local economies, and making sure our women and girls don’t have fewer rights than our grandmothers.

Not going viral has its costs, though—folks who grandstand make Big Money through their online fundraising. While I might not be a TikTok sensation, **the work I do in Congress is essential for good governance, and the ability to win my seat is essential for a good government majority.**

I may not have a viral Twitter presence, but I do have all of you (10,000+ of you, if you can believe it!) who have supported me from the beginning. Peter,
Our border is in crisis.
We need our leaders to take action — not just take pictures at stunt media events. This is a complicated issue, and we aren’t going to solve it with just one bill.
But for the sake of our border communities, we need to do something.
The problem is that Donald Trump doesn’t want to see progress — he wants to see chaos and division because he thinks that will help his reelection chances.
Donald Trump came out against the bipartisan border funding bill — so my opponent, Juan Ciscomani, came out against the bill, too. Now, Trump is on the campaign trail saying immigrants “are not people” and threatening a “bloodbath” if he is not reelected.
This is horrifying, dehumanizing language that only serves to drive us further apart on this issue. I condemn it wholeheartedly.
I had a lot of thoughts about Trump and Ciscomani blocking the funding our border communities desperately. That’s why I published opinion pieces in the Arizona Republic [https://www.azcentral.com/story/opinion/op-ed/2024/02/09/rep-juan-ciscomani-rejects-border-bill-trump/72499722007/] and in Green Valley News [https://www.gvnews.com/opinion/juan-ciscomani-is-failing-us-on-the-border/article_e3c6548a-da9c-11ee-bcb7-6fab2ca01a09.html] unpacking how Ciscomani is letting Arizona down.
Our border communities deserve leaders who will work across the aisle to make progress. That’s exactly what I’ll do in Congress.

# [Sign: If Trump won't pay the $454 million he owes, seize his assets, and put him in jail](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1f59888f-3b86-4c54-b5e7-71cc6a202197/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Donald Trump owes $454 million from his NY civil fraud case, and he's not paying it. The guy who said he was worth "TEN BILLION DOLLARS" and has property all around the world suddenly can't pay what he owes – and is trying to delay the deadline endlessly. [**Tell the Trump judges not to give Trump more time, and to seize his assets and put Trump in jail if he won't pay.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tec5b18b8-17f5-48fc-9d71-38089bb1dc54/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump's attorneys are claiming that 30 different entities have refused to back a bond for the sum. Is it any wonder that the guy who famously doesn't pay his bills can't get someone to lend him money? Trump is trying to appeal the decision, asking the court to pause the $454 million judgment or accept only a $100 million bond. No way! Anyone else in this position would be forced to pay, and to sell assets to get the money, and Trump should not get special treatment. Trump has boasted of his wealth for decades and it's time for him to pay up. If he doesn't have the cash, the courts can and should start freezing his bank accounts and seizing his properties. [**Sign your name to tell the courts: Don't give Trump any more time, make him pay up now!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T44e6194c-d417-47bd-aeba-b6d2c743d720/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

#
Team — Last week, Vice President Kamala Harris toured a Planned Parenthood location in Minnesota. **As President Biden might put it, this is a BFD.** Her visit marks the first known time a sitting president or vice president has toured a Planned Parenthood location. At a time when reproductive rights are under persistent attack from the right-wing, Vice President Harris’ visit reaffirms the Biden-Harris administration’s deep commitment to protecting women’s bodily autonomy. Meanwhile, Donald Trump is trying to pick a vice president who isn’t “too extreme” on abortion rights. That’s rich coming from the person who appointed right-wing ideologues to the Supreme Court that overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , and then _bragged_ about it. **I’m proud and excited by President Biden and Vice President Harris’ willingness to unequivocally support reproductive rights. And I’m ready to support Democrats across the country who will join the Biden Harris administration in protecting and expanding abortion access.** **[If you’re with me, sign on to my pledge to support pro-choice candidates in Minnesota and beyond today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81273937/461926364/-2082954137?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240319_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzM3NjQ1MS0yOWU2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=26YF1KZMfS0s5OOUiqbFM_pwfqyxT7FGv1aJTeU7RB4=&emci=b4376451-29e6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=b7376451-29e6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=6227932)** | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81273938/461926365/-2082954137?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240319_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzM3NjQ1MS0yOWU2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=26YF1KZMfS0s5OOUiqbFM_pwfqyxT7FGv1aJTeU7RB4=&emci=b4376451-29e6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=b7376451-29e6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=6227932)

Getting in Right in Roseto |
---
| | [ ](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=a47abe4855&e=1090c5c412)

|
---
| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

Last Friday, I had the pleasure of working in the kitchen at Columbia Fire Company No. 1 in Roseto. For years, volunteers have been providing Lenten dinners to the Slate Belt community to raise money for the fire company and provide great meals for their neighbors.

These are not your typical fish fries. The food is as good or better than any fine Italian restaurant, and the place runs like a well-oiled machine. Almost 40 volunteers are there every Friday during Lent to prepare the food, serve the meals, and host the guests. I got to wash dishes with my friends Mike and Bill, who were still scrubbing pans at 11 PM.

The Lenten dinners plus the “Big Time” fundraiser that Columbia Fire Company hosts each summer generates just enough money to pay the annual bills for their new fire truck. To accomplish that, I’m guessing volunteers probably spend at least 4,000 hours each year planning, organizing, and executing at these fundraising events. And it’s hard work.

So why do they do it?

Certainly, because they need a fire truck. But also because they love their neighbors.

Events like the Lenten Dinners bring people together. Roseto wouldn’t be the same without the community affairs hosted by the fire company, the American Legion, the Knights of Columbus, or Roseto Helping Hands. Just like it wouldn’t be the same in communities across Pa.’s 7th District without all the church and civic groups helping their neighbors.

I’m often asked how I would help local communities who need money for various causes, and I’m always careful not to make promises I can’t keep. Certainly, there’s a role for the federal government in helping local organizations, especially first responders and emergency services.

But I believe in solving problems at the lowest level. First the family, then the church or civic organization, then the local and state authorities, and lastly, the federal government. This is how our Republic was designed, and this is how it works the best.

In Congress, I’ll work tirelessly to help local people solve local problems. But I’ll also fight to keep the federal government out of local affairs and out of our homes and families. Washington shouldn’t be telling us what vehicles we can drive, what appliances we can use, or what kind of milk our children can drink. And if the federal government didn’t demand so much from us in taxes, local communities could afford more things like fire trucks.

I’ll put my faith in the good people of Pa.’s 7th District instead of the career politicians in Washington. Just look at Roseto. They’ve got it figured out.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. | | | **Cultivate Change: Support Farming on World Agricultural Day****!**
---

Dear Peter,
Today, on World Agricultural Day, we celebrate the backbone of not just our economy in Washington's 8th Congressional District, but the entire globe: our farmers and agricultural workers. Their dedication and hard work feed families, sustain communities, and preserve the traditions that bind us to the land.
Carmen Goers recognizes the importance of agriculture and is committed to policies that support our farmers, protect our environment, and ensure the prosperity of rural communities. Her vision includes investing in sustainable farming practices, expanding market access, and securing the resources necessary for our agricultural sector to thrive.

---
| | | |
---
|
In honor of World Agricultural Day, we’re calling on you to help sow the seeds of progress with a contribution to Carmen’s campaign.
Your donation of $25, $50, or $100 will empower us to advocate for the agricultural initiatives that matter most.

---

| | | Your support today ensures that the voice of agriculture is heard loud and clear in Washington, D.C., promoting growth, innovation, and resilience in our farming communities.

Let’s stand together for the hardworking men and women who keep our tables full and our futures bright. Thank you for your generosity and commitment to a thriving agricultural future.

Sincerely,

Carmen Goers

Our safety is jeopardized by an extreme faction of the Republican party
#

Let us be crystal clear:
Commonsense measures like universal background checks, safe storage laws, and extreme risk protection orders are supported by the vast majority of Americans. For our lawmakers, passing them **_should**_ be a no brainer.
But with the current state of our political system, our safety is jeopardized by an extreme faction of the Republican party who would rather put the gun lobby’s wishes before our safety.
A prime example? The current Speaker of the House has made an active choice to block any gun safety legislation from getting a vote.
It’s unacceptable, and it’s why we must do everything in our power to take back control of the House of Representatives this year.
[**Extremism has no place in our politics, and it’s up to us to elect leaders who will put gun safety first. Happy Women’s History Month! My name is Katherine Clark, and I proudly serve Massachusetts’ 5th district in Congress. I am also in House leadership serving as the Democratic Whip. It wasn’t too long ago when there were hardly any women serving in Congress at all. When I first came to Congress in 2013, I was stopped and mistaken for someone’s spouse (multiple times), making it difficult to even get into the Chamber to cast a vote. Fast forward to today, and thankfully, things have improved. **There are more women serving in Congress than ever before — 94 women in the House Democratic Caucus alone!** But our work is far from over. This election, there’s so much at stake for women. While House Democrats continue to fight for reproductive freedom, Donald Trump brags about overturning _Roe_ , and has promised to lead the charge to ban abortion nationwide. We cannot afford to let their extreme MAGA agenda win — for our freedoms, our families, or our futures. **[That’s why I’m writing to you today. **Meet Bernie Moreno:** | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Fellow American - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

**Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

# ONE OF US - FIGHTING FOR US!
---
---
| Fellow Patriots,
Today, my opponent announced that he does not plan to attend the Oxford County debate scheduled for April 20th. Oxford County GOP has worked tirelessly to plan this event as their top fundraiser for 2024 to support their Republican candidates for the Maine Legislature.
While Austin may have concerns about debating, this event was much more than that and without a doubt, I will be there to support our party and explain why I am the candidate that will defeat Jared Golden this November. I want at least three debates and Oxford should be one of them. We can't let the people of Oxford County down.
Quite frankly, our focus regardless of primaries should be unifying Republicans across this state behind the candidates that provide us the best path to victory on Election Day in November. If a candidate for Congress is worried about debate logistics and audiences, then they are not the candidate for the general against Jared Golden. If you can't handle a Marine in the primary, you're not going to beat one in the general election.
On April 20th, I will join my fellow Republicans at the Legion in Greenwood. I hope that you will join me in purchasing tickets to support Oxford County Republicans and join me while I answer debate questions with or without an opponent.
See you there and stay safe,
Mike

BREAKING NEWS, Peter:
**The Supreme Court just ruled that Texas can enforce SB4—Texas’s blatantly unconstitutional and dangerous “show me your papers” law—while litigation continues.**
Let’s be clear: as I write this email, Texas law enforcement now has the authority to arrest any person they suspect of being undocumented, detain them, and put them in front of state judges who can summarily remove them from the U.S., without the due process of an asylum claim.
This law is dangerous, it’s cruel, and it puts a target on the back of Brown and Black people in Texas. It’s also blatantly unconstitutional and flies in the face of decades of precedent that the federal government has sole authority over immigration enforcement. Abbott and the Trump-packed Supreme Court could be working to make our community safer, but instead they’ve chosen to scapegoat immigrants and cause harm.
This fight isn’t over. While this law is debated in the lower courts, we MUST keep up the pressure. This is a make or break moment for immigrants’ rights, for Texas, and for the rule of law.

Here's the truth: Joe Biden needs A LOT of donations today to make sure we keep Trump out of the White House. This is going to be a very close and very expensive race, and the President can't do it alone. If everyone getting this email donated even $10, we'd be on track to reach our fundraising goals for March. Unfortunately, not everyone gives. So the President is counting on those who know the stakes to chip in today -- especially today. | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | We need a big day today. For our President. For America. Team Joe

body:
#
If we want to reach young people and get them involved before the far-right does, we need to get creative. **And that’s exactly what Maxwell Frost is doing.**
Earlier this month, I teamed up with Maxwell as a headliner for his new Music and Arts Festival, MadSoul Fest. In just one day, the MadSoul team welcomed 3,000 guests and registered hundreds of voters — **all in time for this year's elections**.
Maxwell is changing the organizing game. And that’s so important at this moment, because **we know that the same old organizing tactics won’t deliver a new generation of voters**.
[Will you split a $5 contribution between Maxwell and my campaign today so that we can keep fighting to grow our progressive movement and build power for the next generation?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240319-frost.0YuxO0&refcode=em20240319-6030-P_FND_SPL_CTR&t=1&akid=6030%2E2526796%2Eca-WIs)
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240319-frost.0YuxO0&refcode=em20240319-6030-P_FND_SPL_CTR&t=2&akid=6030%2E2526796%2Eca-WIs)
_Rep. Greg Casar, Rep. Maxwell Frost, International President of the Association of Flight Attendants-CWA, AFL-CIO Sara Nelson, and AOC at MadSoul Festival._
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240319-frost.0YuxO0&refcode=em20240319-6030-P_FND_SPL_CTR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=6030%2E2526796%2Eca-WIs)**
This is just one way Maxwell is doing things differently.
He’s organizing year-round at concerts, college campuses, and outreach events. And we’re seeing the results – not just in the news, but at the ballot box, too.
Maxwell and I each rely entirely on grassroots support to keep expanding our reach to young people everywhere. And we each have our doubters who are watching like hawks to see if this movement is really as powerful as we say. That’s where you come in:
[Will you make a contribution of $5, or anything you can, today to power both of our year-round organizing efforts? Together we can build an unstoppable youth-powered movement, and we will win a brighter future for all. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240319-frost.0YuxO0&refcode=em20240319-6030-P_FND_SPL_CTR&t=4&akid=6030%2E2526796%2Eca-WIs)

With gratitude,
Alexandria

* * *
[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=6e0a84782b7b4cd7a1745d9627ed21c7&_e=XcWsn5gJx-pxFWAUu1F6zpij38uTMN8WnY-CFC1-ebCEMZgBSYUZ1S6CV_s_Sj732hrZQ7GMzvJ9DJifhD57cCdd0nWM2CQsTUrkoAUbwGUVvGc88TjQKUss45K-On97d7J0NYO_xYNhUXwMdjjfsVDYmnlIQQl_5B-sGLZWgNSrzN3mH3pA76apHeSd3kmTf9gxdVMP4ImlsBvg4q4wv28ov0ZnejBT3a6SMu-PAwsNTBoknQdccTbEmOI8C9AcS5YPDthh8hLOmZCzvFbz6PN5hbTzaPDl6IJrDNqdAnrGORNXKdhlcYjgIEU0lI3fVyLzXIKr925kz5iyoOXRkWX8fqGAUe7M5gw5jpiHCNb27heUCIaDEpLW_AMSJj8p80Ie1MR4hXtTJMSQiGeNtA%3D%3D)
Out of the blue, Democratic CD 2 Rep. Gabe Vasquez seems to have started paying attention to the crisis at the border—or has seen the recent polls rather—and has joined the “Democrats for Border Security Task Force.”

Democrats for _border security?_ Now that’s an oxymoron.

**Let's get some of the facts straight on Rep. Gabe Vasquez and the border:**

* Gabe Vasquez completely ignored the border until it became the worst humanitarian and influx crisis in history.

* Gabe referred to the growing crisis at the border as a _"non-existent threat."_

* He repeatedly called the border wall _"racist"_ and tweeted that he wanted to _"tear it down."_

[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=6e0a84782b7b4cd7a1745d9627ed21c7&_e=XcWsn5gJx-pxFWAUu1F6zpij38uTMN8WnY-CFC1-ebCEMZgBSYUZ1S6CV_s_Sj732hrZQ7GMzvJ9DJifhD57cCdd0nWM2CQsTUrkoAUbwGUVvGc88TjQKUss45K-On97d7J0NYO_xYNhUXwMdjjfsVDYmnlIQQl_5B-sGLZWgNSrzN3mH3pA76apHeSd3kmTf9gxdVMP4ImlsBvg4q4wv28ov0ZnejBT3a6SMu-PAwsNTBoknQdccTbEmOI8C9Acv941yfPHzSDGlwz1nwBqzIpj8raTvSa8F2ueewWs7-7NY0XY-sKDiP2V3X_RscHkuGHr84z3YXHyt0HUozT313dHanJ5cHN2skEQI-yqC5ZVMCyUbghxdNp5FSAP2HivFpNVcpU6TqsQeVaQa3z9Uw%3D%3D)

* He praised Biden’s executive orders that began on day one to open up the border.

[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=6e0a84782b7b4cd7a1745d9627ed21c7&_e=XcWsn5gJx-pxFWAUu1F6zpij38uTMN8WnY-CFC1-ebCEMZgBSYUZ1S6CV_s_Sj732hrZQ7GMzvJ9DJifhD57cCdd0nWM2CQsTUrkoAUbwGUVvGc88TjQKUss45K-On97d7J0NYO_xYNhUXwMdjjfsVDYmnlIQQl_5B-sGLZWgNSrzN3mH3pA76apHeSd3kmTf9gxdVMP4ImlsBvg4q4wv28ov0ZnejBT3a6SMu-PAwsNTBoknQdccTbEmOI8C9Ac8SbTE5SKZB4MIhVAMZhJ-P1KoOJvqL4KFW0jIEEVcvmsFkavjo7Q2C1PFJDNuluukJTea7LIiWCQ67bK4Tq-t5uJl5_CCDFFqC_IxQkjPs2S0FRzzaO5tkqLO8I0twOtXpIqwf5e4MJbMxlMj0OPRw%3D%3D)

* He disparaged the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) constantly.

[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=6e0a84782b7b4cd7a1745d9627ed21c7&_e=XcWsn5gJx-pxFWAUu1F6zpij38uTMN8WnY-CFC1-ebCEMZgBSYUZ1S6CV_s_Sj732hrZQ7GMzvJ9DJifhD57cCdd0nWM2CQsTUrkoAUbwGUVvGc88TjQKUss45K-On97d7J0NYO_xYNhUXwMdjjfsVDYmnlIQQl_5B-sGLZWgNSrzN3mH3pA76apHeSd3kmTf9gxdVMP4ImlsBvg4q4wv28ov0ZnejBT3a6SMu-PAwsNTBoknQdccTbEmOI8C9AcMgXAnoc8mAagcpybF1AcgzKraacQwP22OF5vmtewtcQd_Q3D4-FcdidH0EJ9IO1rL6DhABGUJGeQMKQcSBSus9mldmbekUDwhE_jo-yWRN4J3mNjHEIjKVYiICkl-iTHNk1poH6Beivg7BzqwVZtSA%3D%3D)

* Then, in Congress, **right before the end of Title 42** , he (along with the rest of the NM Democratic U.S. Reps) voted **AGAINST** the _Secure the Border Act_ , the most comprehensive stand-alone border security bill in recent history.

[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=6e0a84782b7b4cd7a1745d9627ed21c7&_e=XcWsn5gJx-pxFWAUu1F6zpij38uTMN8WnY-CFC1-ebCEMZgBSYUZ1S6CV_s_Sj732hrZQ7GMzvJ9DJifhD57cCdd0nWM2CQsTUrkoAUbwGUVvGc88TjQKUss45K-On97d7J0NYO_xYNhUXwMdjjfsVDYmnlIQQl_5B-sGLZWgNSrzN3mH3pA76apHeSd3kmTf9gxdVMP4ImlsBvg4q4wv28ov0ZnejBT3a6SMu-PAwsNTBoknQdccTbEmOI8C9AcDZwTjEOuOdXljdcXz5RCbC4gwdyJlRybIqhGx_cBP1-ldEXciWg6MJ8S2lhLgoLQEAGnCGe_y5TEBi3QZndhOtVRUrd5-XuE2y-oP6YjLYmUJtEKa4DMBrwaIQRZWFMDZeAPhndWfd7EgdoVA3taHg%3D%3D)

Res. 957, Denouncing the Biden administration's open-borders policies, condemning the national security and public safety crisis along the southwest border, and urging President Biden to end his administration's open-borders policies.**

[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=6e0a84782b7b4cd7a1745d9627ed21c7&_e=XcWsn5gJx-pxFWAUu1F6zpij38uTMN8WnY-CFC1-ebCEMZgBSYUZ1S6CV_s_Sj732hrZQ7GMzvJ9DJifhD57cCdd0nWM2CQsTUrkoAUbwGUVvGc88TjQKUss45K-On97d7J0NYO_xYNhUXwMdjjfsVDYmnlIQQl_5B-sGLZWgNSrzN3mH3pA76apHeSd3kmTf9gxdVMP4ImlsBvg4q4wv28ov0ZnejBT3a6SMu-PAwsNTBoknQdccTbEmOI8C9Acy9_n16P4_MIL1rNadR8Ag_FVc7Yv3inxwHTijHF5dUROLoE3A1e6TwvYOpS3JQ6lK_jHZ0GrywX2SWHe7apwDee5Yxlok6MeVxzx2R9QVQRZiOxwoI7xAN4IqFTR33T_Gk-9dOH48asUOf_DB08FHQ%3D%3D)

clean_body: Support me in the Ohio Primary Election today and let’s put America First! | | Peter, Today is the day we’ve been working towards:Election Day is here in Ohio. As the hours tick by, I am filled with gratitude for the support and dedication you have shown to our campaign. I am proud to stand as a fierce, America First conservative, ready to fight for you every single day in Washington. I’ve been endorsed by everyone from Jim Jordan, to JD Vance and even President Donald J. Trump himself. But at the end of the day, the only endorsement that matters is YOURS! Our work in this primary election isn’t over yet. I need your support now more than ever before the polls close. Here’s how you can help in these closing hours: Every donation and every vote counts. Let’s finish strong today and send a resounding message that Ohioans are ready to send a strong, unwavering voice to the Senate. Thank you for being a part of this critical journey. To victory, Bernie Moreno Republican for U.S. Senate - Ohio Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. _**CW: This email discusses topics around pregnancy, birth defects, and newborn health.**_ **\--------------** As a mother and grandmother, I want to talk to you about something that hits close to home for me: the effects of oil drilling on pregnancy and newborn health. **Recent studies across Texas and California show that pregnant people who live near active oil and gas wells are at a higher risk of giving birth to babies with low birth weights, just as previous studies have found in Louisiana’s “Cancer Alley” and beyond.** This includes a study that links active oil and gas wells to premature birth and heart defects. People who live close to active wells also faced a higher likelihood of having babies that were small for their gestational age — and the impacts were exacerbated for women living in rural areas. But this issue goes beyond birth weight: Researchers say that babies born of low birth weight are at higher risk for health problems as they get older. **Imagine. Simply because of where they come into the world, these babies and their families are forced to undergo prolonged and expensive health battles and face developmental hurdles that no tiny human should ever have to.** And the worst part? _Big Oil couldn’t care less._ While state and local governments across the country are starting to take action to protect communities from deadly fossil fuel projects, the oil & gas industry is doing everything they can to stop them. In fact, in California they’ve started running very slick, well-produced ads about why California needs MORE oil and gas. The influence of the fossil fuel industry has polluted our political system and put a halt to crucial legislation that would protect our communities and, most importantly, our children. **The Jane Fonda Climate PAC is fighting back. Not only are we pushing back against the environmental recklessness of these greedy corporations, but we are fighting to elect climate champions who will pass meaningful legislation that prioritizes a sustainable future for our children.** We are mobilizing to educate voters and to ensure that the voices of the most vulnerable are heard loud and clear. But we cannot do this alone. Your support, whether it’s by sharing this message, making a small donation, volunteering for our endorsed candidates, or anything in between, will help our efforts to protect our communities from the dangers of toxic oil drilling. Peter,

Last week, Vice President Kamala Harris visited an abortion clinic in Minnesota, a historic first for a Vice President, and declared that the lack of access to reproductive care has spiraled into a _**"health crisis."**_

In 2022, the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , leaving the right to abortion up to individual states and criminalizing healthcare providers who provided life-saving procedures. Since then, a MAGA Republican-led movement set a dangerous precedent further restricting women’s bodily autonomy. Like Vice President Harris said during her visit to the clinic – _**we have to be a nation that trusts women to make their own healthcare decisions.**_

At Emerge, we strongly believe it's crucial to empower Democratic women to be at the forefront of the fight to protect our reproductive freedom. Peter - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

**Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

_Someone who didn’t grow up with a silver spoon in their mouth._

[**It’s people like you and me who should be representing America – not the liberal elites who are used to always getting their way (or buying their way).**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=39e8d845b4fd4d4fb6e40ac5d1275bae&_e=jIu89lqTPz8OI34iGmjBDAIVy_Pe6Pj-Fb0493pJFuDwlrdP81OuFpxA3Loa21FSMUhcxzhi5Oj6WbXtlZqif7d8R4n_C6UDLvO0_ehhqvScs4YLWaiFCiz8KUqOvfORxGd20xS1wyzJR0gCirXEvv61EWyBZPV9cWfzMURdHZg-Yymjs554UNLG0QdH1BvhqUXPdaK2dxPopSSr6-iFgU02Xf1EUoBrpR372ErJy44e2SAsq3vwfVOgrWDkgD5U-g0Ud-lNlSV2Slf5zFfcW-kdfwYNgQbefk_Max8fVqOV-jQr82pmSpCEnKuGVd-eRmV_iQ9KEn-eDBPVMt4GB73i8-cOiiG5nsZi5VKOQuoOUNFwWXjbJ0MnpV79No0sXBNBraOV6_Jive5XYQVSBQ%3D%3D)

[** ****SEND ME BACK TO WASHINGTON » **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=39e8d845b4fd4d4fb6e40ac5d1275bae&_e=jIu89lqTPz8OI34iGmjBDAIVy_Pe6Pj-Fb0493pJFuDwlrdP81OuFpxA3Loa21FSMUhcxzhi5Oj6WbXtlZqif7d8R4n_C6UDLvO0_ehhqvScs4YLWaiFCiz8KUqOvfORxGd20xS1wyzJR0gCirXEvv61EWyBZPV9cWfzMURdHZg-Yymjs554UNLG0QdH1BvhqUXPdaK2dxPopSSr6-iFgU02Xf1EUoBrpR372ErJy44e2SAsq3vwfVOgrWDkgD5U_RFX-mbfSsUHQn4MeQN1_PbvszlkDscDksar0UakaGxSoRT_nnTDcJl2ADXrI3E7kOiWe3IdcyVnIf0RWS6TRRJVLL0ACZGKiu1y0Vdi1CYhLRzGcm15I3znwYe0Ba8zxwQWJU7J39dYKqYP5JETww%3D%3D)

I am taking the same ambition to Congress, to fight for you. Nancy Mace
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=39e8d845b4fd4d4fb6e40ac5d1275bae&_e=jIu89lqTPz8OI34iGmjBDAIVy_Pe6Pj-Fb0493pJFuDwlrdP81OuFpxA3Loa21FSMUhcxzhi5Oj6WbXtlZqif7d8R4n_C6UDLvO0_ehhqvScs4YLWaiFCiz8KUqOvfORxGd20xS1wyzJR0gCirXEvv61EWyBZPV9cWfzMURdHZg-Yymjs554UNLG0QdH1BvhqUXPdaK2dxPopSSr6-iFgU02Xf1EUoBrpR372ErJy44e2SAsq3vwfVOgrWDkgD5Ud5ppIOIxTFJO_hkeENNuerhZjcZJfWuqxEnCV8wn86WJc5j1jOJ4jlWr5Z0L5tet75uEAyaVNBozN-hUX4FTfwNFSjeEHXvX8b4k5jFQ5TfY0AGv4LCWnQy01MzPC2KB7eDyEstj1r_wTpUoTOLiLQ%3D%3D)

| Friend,
We won! Thank you to everyone who voted in this election. I am truly humbled by your support. I'd like to especially thank everyone who volunteered with the campaign or supported our effort financially. I am so thankful for your support.

| Now is the time to unite as Republicans. We must stand together to defeat the Swamp and bring positive change to our nation's capital.
We have completed the first step of our journey, but we are FAR from finished. I'm going to need a lot of help. We must show that people really care about flipping this seat red in November. The best way to demonstrate that is with a financial contribution, even if it is only [$10 or $20](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V3Xf2ya9gabOCb8zTFgXfsPXURjNl3uh2CjwRT95kTTeVo0N1-sVenxGhezxxAGRqgf0uww2ZR3dBC95pgZp-0Olo-olVONG-3sHz2UVl3Y_zvXbOpWHrKDqwblIb3eGyzPbBjZI0hkPOByQriVnjsRsGcJOxXopi0tB-MEC1vpNt_c1NnBOdv-4Cnycd7HXirmXGpvPjpk=&c=XNkmex9q_NQH-K8pA0McAEBVcoxuXx1y3L0Gg68M5e0o-o0SiEiCCg==&ch=zrkcRgRn2SPw0e0irrO5tT35AU6AzyQp-USEr1hP1D7kM6sw2KOxiA==). Every donor and every donation sends a signal that Republicans are determined to take back IL-11 and there is a unified grassroots energy behind our campaign.
We will be facing Democrat Bill Foster in the general election in November. I will need your support and vote in November as we try to bring common sense change to a broken system in Washington D.C. My goal is to make our area the best place to live, work, and raise a family!

| | Friend, Last month Senators Warnock and Durbin reintroduced the _John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act_ and we couldn’t be more excited! After the gutting of the _Voting Rights Act of 1965_ , we’ve seen a rise of voter suppression laws across the country targeting people of color. Not since the Jim Crow era have we seen such brazenly racist attacks on our right to vote, but the _John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act_ will ensure that no voters are kept from the ballot box on account of their race. The Act will establish new criteria for preventing discrimination in voting, mandate higher standards of nationwide transparency for voting law and policy changes, and more important steps that will ensure that racism plays no role in people’s access to the vote. It’s 2024 and it’s time to stop racist voter suppression and restore the _Voting Rights Act_ to its full potential once and for all. **[ECU/LAV Action Fund is dedicated to stopping voter suppression and protecting the right to vote for all Americans, regardless of race. But we can’t do it alone. So please, if you value our democracy and you believe that our elections should truly be fair, chip in $10 today and join us in the fight.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81281199/461949833/444630146?refcode=3-18-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNlZDU3MzdkLTQxZTYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=El8tAFsC6zKTQeDrJVyIRCS5GQMLza4m2L4tx69XeI0=)** The late, great Congressman John Lewis dedicated his entire life to fighting against racial injustice and ensuring that the voice of every single American is heard. He would be _so_ disappointed to see the restrictive, racist voter suppression laws across our country today. We need to act now to uphold his legacy and create a democracy that works for all of us. [**Congress needs to fulfill their obligations to protect the freedom to vote by passing the**** _John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act_****as soon as possible. There is no better way to honor John Lewis than ridding America of its racist voter suppression laws and ensuring equal ballot box access for every single voter. If you’re ready to protect the right to vote, contribute $10 now and join ECU/LAV Action Fund in the fight.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81281200/461949834/444630146?refcode=3-18-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNlZDU3MzdkLTQxZTYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=El8tAFsC6zKTQeDrJVyIRCS5GQMLza4m2L4tx69XeI0=) Thank you,— Team ECU/LAV Action

body:
In the wealthiest nation on earth, any person left without health coverage is a moral failing. |
---

Team, **I believe that health care is a human right** — and that in the wealthiest nation on earth, any person left without health coverage is a moral failing. It’s safe to say we have a lot of work to do to bring costs down and expand access. That’s why as Chair of the Health Committee in the Delaware Senate, I’ve passed legislation expanding access to care, and just this week I announced legislation that would mark **the largest ongoing investment in Medicaid in Delaware** since the passage of the Affordable Care Act. In Congress, I’ll support any positive policy that advances our country toward the ultimate goal of universal coverage. But not everyone in Washington shares that goal. **Donald Trump has recently promised to revive efforts to repeal the Affordable Care Act** , which would rip care away from our neighbors, not make it more affordable. So as we approach the 14th anniversary of the signing of the Affordable Care Act this Saturday, I wanted to make my position clear: I will work to **stop** any effort to rip health care access away from Americans, and I will do everything in my power to make sure we **expand** access to care instead. **[If you’re with me in the fight to lower costs and get more of our neighbors covered, will you sign on to my petition calling for expanded health care access today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81281494/461950413/115632537?refcode=em20240319&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjI0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Y2NmYmExYi00M2U2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KnpnkntbMj16VcjZHaHmicDhyfCF2cmM7Mni5paCTw4=&emci=47cfba1b-43e6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=4ccfba1b-43e6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=36397936)** | [Add Your Name](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81281495/461950414/115632537?refcode=em20240319&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjI0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Y2NmYmExYi00M2U2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KnpnkntbMj16VcjZHaHmicDhyfCF2cmM7Mni5paCTw4=&emci=47cfba1b-43e6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=4ccfba1b-43e6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=36397936)

clean_body: In the wealthiest nation on earth, any person left without health coverage is a moral failing. | Team, I believe that health care is a human right — and that in the wealthiest nation on earth, any person left without health coverage is a moral failing. It’s safe to say we have a lot of work to do to bring costs down and expand access. That’s why as Chair of the Health Committee in the Delaware Senate, I’ve passed legislation expanding access to care, and just this week I announced legislation that would mark the largest ongoing investment in Medicaid in Delaware since the passage of the Affordable Care Act. In Congress, I’ll support any positive policy that advances our country toward the ultimate goal of universal coverage. But not everyone in Washington shares that goal. Donald Trump has recently promised to revive efforts to repeal the Affordable Care Act , which would rip care away from our neighbors, not make it more affordable. So as we approach the 14th anniversary of the signing of the Affordable Care Act this Saturday, I wanted to make my position clear: I will work to stop any effort to rip health care access away from Americans, and I will do everything in my power to make sure we expand access to care instead. | Thank you, team. Sarah McBride | Sarah McBride serves her home state in the Delaware State Senate, where she has passed historic paid leave, gun safety, and nondiscrimination laws. We did it!
Our congressional district is 36 counties, over 40% of the landmass of Michigan; the second largest Congressional district east of the Mississippi River; a district the size of Ireland.
And, as of just now, our campaign has gathered nominating petition signatures from all 36 counties! What an effort!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
We encourage residents to continue showing up to our petition drives; we haven't yet hit the maximum number of required signatures, but...
You can help us celebrate a major milestone with a $36 contribution tonight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=36&refcode=express_lane_36] Your donation enables our staff and volunteers to reach every corner of Michigan's 1st District. We're so grateful.
RUSH A $36 CONTRIBUTION [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=36&refcode=express_lane_36]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately.
Friends,
We have traveled, heard stories, and earned the trust of people across the district. Republicans, Independents, and Democrats are hearing our positive message of bringing people together and working to advocate for policies that would benefit our communities.
Just this week, I have personally traveled and talked to voters in Pickford, Lake City, Newberry, Sault Ste. Marie, Traverse City, Atlanta, Negaunee, Buckley, Marquette, and Blair.
This weekend I will be in Alpena and Cheboygan. Our field team is making sure no area in our massive district is left behind, ensuring rural voices are heard, seen, and valued.
Major thanks to our wonderful volunteers who help gather petitions day in and day out, I cannot thank you enough. Take some time tonight to celebrate your hard work.
You can sign up here if you’d like to join our volunteer team: votedrbob.com/volunteer [https://www.votedrbob.com/volunteer]

| Friends, Thanks to everyone who showed up tonight. "We the People" scored a huge win tonight.
Our entire "Re-unite the Red" ticket won. So congratulations!
Those of you who have been dismissed, discarded, minimized or kicked out of the Chesterfield GOP are now welcome back. I'll be sending you information on upcoming meetings. We need to grow our GOP and make Chesterfield solid red.
We need to unify the party and make it a welcoming friendly committee that gets Republicans elected.
The turnout for the "Re-unite the Red" was overwhelming. Over 650 votes were cast tonight. Here's the break down.
GOP CHAIR Dee Dee Van Buren 430 Leslie Haley 215
VICE CHAIR Leslie Matthews 439 Sarah Mahayni 207
RECORDING SECRETARY Cheryl McMillan 412 Ashley Abplanalp 234
TREASURER Tommy Owens 428 Jim Williams 218
CORRESPONDING SECRETARY Curt Powell 354 Cody Porter 231
They were not expecting you to show up, but you did.
We overwhelmed the vote tonight and our "Re-unite the Red" grassroots ticket won. The average wait in line was at least an hour, but now aren't you glad you waited in the cold?
We overwhelmed all of their shenanigans tonight despite their efforts.
I'm sure it doesn't surprise you that they refused to allow me to vote.
I'm a registered voter, Republican Senator of 8 years who served our community and they refused to allow me to vote, presenting me with a letter advising me that based on my actions during the 2023 Election Cycle, that I had chosen to withdraw my membership from the Republican Party of Virginia and thus my ability to participate in the party process for four years.
Interestingly enough, the letter addressed to me, was signed by the Chesterfield County Republican Committee, but there was no vote taken by the membership committee to expel me.
Thank God we won! I look forward to appealing this ridiculous letter by Leslie Haley and her crony executive committee. I look forward to rejoining the Chesterfield GOP and being an active member there. My hope is that you will too.
---
|

What they did to me tonight is typical. They hate me because I stand up for you to ensure you have a vote and that you have a voice. Together, we did it.
Thank you for coming out to vote. I so look forward to a Chesterfield GOP that allows the Republicans of Chesterfield, not just the elite to participate in our Republican nomination processes.
Together we will make the Chesterfield GOP great again and get Donald J Trump and our U.S. Senate Republican nominee elected this coming November.

Friends, Every year, Women’s History Month serves as an opportunity to reflect on how far we’ve come in the fight for gender equality and reproductive freedom — and as a reminder of how much work we have left to do. **I’m grateful for some of the extraordinary women in my life who’ve made me who I am today.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81282577/461954197/476240478?refcode=em_eng_2024.03.19_b1_jb_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGRmYTBkNWYtNDZlNi1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=MD-RwNYWm6L1OHEhC6Ai8wXURRZXC2fyrq7H06-mQ_w=) Women like my grandmother, Mattie Brown, who no matter what, always fought to make sure I had everything I needed. If there was anything my parents couldn’t provide, she would always fill in. Her dedication to our family inspires me every day. Or my mother, who graduated high school as the valedictorian of one of the last segregated high schools. But in the South, there wasn't a clear path for her after graduation. She found opportunity in DC: working at the FBI, earning teaching and counseling degrees, and serving in public schools for thirty years. I am so proud to be her daughter. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81282578/461954198/476240478?refcode=em_eng_2024.03.19_b1_jb_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGRmYTBkNWYtNDZlNi1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=MD-RwNYWm6L1OHEhC6Ai8wXURRZXC2fyrq7H06-mQ_w=) While Women’s History Month serves as an opportunity to celebrate trailblazing women and reflect on how far our country has come in the fight for gender equality — our work is nowhere near finished. **Extremist Republicans are trying to turn back the clock on all the progress we’ve made. But if we come together, we can build a better future for women everywhere. ** We have to protect access to reproductive healthcare, expand childcare, eliminate the wage gap, and so much more. That’s what’s at stake in this election, and that’s why I’m in this fight. I’m so proud to have you by my side and together, I know we’ll get the job done. | | For Immediate Release
March 19, 2024
Contact: Tim Rosales | 916.475.4900
**21st Congressional District and local Businessman Michael Maher receives endorsement from Assemblyman Vince Fong**
Fresno - Former law enforcement professional, local businessman, and top-two candidate for the 21st Congressional District seat, Michael Maher, has earned the endorsement of State Assemblyman Vince Fong. Fong has represented the 32nd State Assembly District since 2016, and his district includes portions of Tulare County.

Assemblyman Fong joins a notable list of Central Valley endorsements of Michael Maher for Congress, including Congressman Tom McClintock, former Congresswoman Connie Conway, State Senator Shannon Grove, and Tulare County Sheriff Mike Boudreaux.

"I'm honored to receive Assemblyman Fong's support. Both of us grew up in the Central Valley and have worked hard to build its future," noted Michael Maher.

"I am also thrilled at how we over-performed in the March Primary and how competitive and close this race for the 21st Congressional District will be. Based on my conversations at doorsteps with voters, I know that Republicans, Democrats, and independents are eager for change and someone to deliver for them."

Businessman Michael Maher will face incumbent Congressman Jim Costa in the November Election in a race already receiving regional and national attention. While Democrats hold a 16-point registration advantage, with votes still being counted, Maher has received 20% more vote percentage than Republican registration percentage, and only a few total percentage points separate Maher and Costa. Michael Maher received strong support in the March Primary from Republicans, Democrats, and independent voters, boosting the opportunity for flipping this Congressional seat.
---
|
---
| **About:** Michael Maher grew up in Tulare County where he owns and operates a Central Valley based aviation business. Maher’s parents settled in Visalia, where his father still serves as a local pastor. His wife Anne comes from a local multigenerational farming family and they have two children.

Maher is a United States Navy veteran, and served abroad the USS Salt Lake City, a Los Angeles Class Fast Attack Submarine. Following the Navy, Michael graduated from Fresno Pacific University and then was accepted and graduated from FBI Academy in Quantico, Virginia. Michael served as a Special Agent for the Bureau working in the National Security Division. Additionally with the FBI, Maher was the Counterproliferation Coordinator for the Los Angeles Field Office which included responsibility in supervision of Chemical Weapons Inspections.

Peter - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

**Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

_Someone who didn’t grow up with a silver spoon in their mouth._

[**It’s people like you and me who should be representing America – not the liberal elites who are used to always getting their way (or buying their way).**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=2324317cd4ce43b0ad93724b51c83779&_e=WphOtamA7IPySUUKI0qtLxnIANSFVa7NqQobf77VcaDAR-acjdsiyjTK8Eo4oN8Gc-KIN5iHpgysD7wekIBls-whRHcESOl1WGGgd5O44Ocnsg9ti4v-8dQ769JksiaaMvt-RX3ZryxHHFWeBh1rEFX_SWcRL1OgLZjNu03Qa3pLBgXyMmcW0L6pgEUxfUk2AaJD0OM7MPXqgiphrHIzrJ9d7QjXi8nMJKF-li_ILT0hhi2LAY6qjP3nELoeH9shYhAWiM5-WKHDoZOh5P6IzzS-5zS5pc9cLypHjo_2MomWc69RqrfTxMrsfvj4dUrz6Mozs7C78AJ12RdNJFFi5HVa5n62M96KBTT89Q_UfCkgr8kjKDWZ40RnCgs2nx43XTqFRsIXYYQTm9A0Cmyi0A%3D%3D)

**But here’s where I need your help – the rich continue to run Congress because they have the funds to do so._But I have you..._**

[**I’m relying on the support of grassroots donors who want to see real change happen in America.
